name: Videogame Reality
description: With this ability, you can make anyone and anything from any and all videogames real. Anything that you summon from a videogame keeps their videogame physics. Anyone you summon from a videogame keeps their personality and skills. The more familiar you are with videogames, the more useful this power becomes to you. You can also summon energies from videogames. And you can always send it back to the videogame.
summary: The ability to make anything and anyone from any videogame real.
strengths: Able to summon energies, artifacts, characters, and more from videogames.
Anything summoned from a videogame follows that game's laws of physics.
Works with any videogame.
weaknesses: If you're not familiar with videogames.
If you have never played or heard about videogames.
If you don't know what a videogame is.

name: Real Gamer
description: With this power you can use any item that can be used in a video game. Magic mushrooms, poke balls, Maxwell's notebook, Link's swords and many more items and weapons can be brought to the real world with this power. When you're done with the items you can send them back to wherever they came from. You can only summon items from video games that you have played.
summary: The ability to use items from video games
strengths: You can have any item from any video game
weaknesses: You can only summon items from video games that you have played

name: Unlock True Potential
description: You have the power to unlock someone's true potential.   You might do this by some personalized ritual or by placing your hand on that person's head and scanning for the hidden power within that person.   When you unlocked someone's true potential then that person will have all his/her abilities increased to the potential maximum for that person.
summary: The ability to unlock someone's true potential
strengths: The person with unlocked potential will be gratefull
weaknesses: You can only unlock the true potential of someone else

name: Astrakinesis
description: Also called Ectokinesis or Psychic/Astral/Spirit/Spiritual Energy/Ectoplasm Manipulation, this is the psychic ability to manipulate ectoplasm, psychic and astral energies (and ectenic force, which allows telekinesis). One with this ability can summon and launch astral, psychic or ectoplasmic energy as rays, concussive beams, astral shrapnel, etc. This ability could even be used to perform or induce Astral Projection, augment certain psychic abilities and affect spiritual manifestations with ease
summary: The ability to psychically manipulate psychic energy, ectoplasm and ectenic force
strengths: Induce or prevent Astral Projection (by yourself and others) and enhance certain psychic abilities
Cause ghosts and spirits to manifest, keep them from manifesting, and harm them with ease
Cover everyday objects in astral energy to use as weapons
weaknesses: Can't manipulate magic
Can't communicate with or control ghosts (even though you can harm or rejuvenate them)
Can't totally destroy a spirit (similar to the first law of thermodynamics)

name: Arch Demon
description: Users with this ability either is or can transform into a demon. Most commonly user retains their general form but with some additions; horns, retractable claws, fangs, tail, wings, more muscular body and can have colour changes, mainly red, blue or black. You can also summon lesser demons, use demonic energy for spells or energy attacks.
summary: The ability to become a demon
strengths: Vast energy powers
Summon other Hellish creatures
Fly
weaknesses: Your'e not neccesarily evil, but the powers push you that way
Strong Angelic/Good beings can beat you

name: Summon
description: All you would have to do would be imagine the creature you want to summon and pick an area. In the area a magical sign(varies per creature)will appear and glow really bright than flash out. In its place would be the creature you imagined. The creature would be under your control and have one small magical power(you choose). You could make more than one of the same creature at one time depending on its size. The smallest it can be is 1cu foot and the largest is 10cu feet. You can also vanish them
summary: The ability to summon creatures from your imagination
strengths: Can summon any magical creature you can imagine that is at your control
The summonings are fast and cool to watch
The smaller the creature the more you can make at once
weaknesses: Summonings are hard to hide.
People will want magical pets
Can't summon objects

name: Supernatural Sense
description: You hear the sound of thunder in your head that alerts you something Supernatural is in the area of where you are or something Supernatural could happen.  This includes but not limited to Demons Vampires, Ghosts, Sorcerers, people using dark magic,demon possession of a human or animal, a person summoning a demon or decided to summon a demon.
summary: The ability to be alerted when something Supernatural is where you are
strengths: The Sound of the Supernatural Sense is Loud so hard not to hear it
Useful for fighting Supernatural Enemies
If loud noise or something else prevented you from hearing it, it will repeat until you hear it
weaknesses: It doesn't tell you spefically what Supernatural it is in the area
Sorcerers and Others very Powerful Can Block It
Can disturb you when on vaction, sleeping, eating at a restaurant, seeing a movie, etc

name: Awakened Mage
description: After having your magic power awakened, you can cast spells personalized to you from your spellbook. The spellbook describes each spell in detail. As your magic power grows, so does the spellbook and the number of spells you cast. Which spells you get are determined by how you use the spells you already have.
summary: The ability to cast your own personalized spells
strengths: Can cast a wide range of spells
Spells are custom to your personality and habits
weaknesses: Can't choose what spells you get

name: Potion Creation
description: This power allows you to brew potions with many effects. You don't have to be magical to make them, it's just that magic-users are more adept at it. You can get lots of ingredients and brew an awesome potion. They can have many effects! You can also make splash potions (throwable potions held in bottles of non-damaging glass). Potions could be in the form of stew, soup, jelly, pills, candy, or just a basic drink like most. It all depends on how you want to make it!
summary: The ability to brew potions.
strengths: Get a boost in power with a potion.
Your combat is affected very positively so you can fight better.
You can even make a potion which gets you better grades!
weaknesses: Sometimes potions have negative effects.
If you brew it wrong, it could backfire badly.
Not all potion effects last forever...

name: Mythical Weapon Summon
description: With this power you can summon and use any weapon used in any mythology, from Excalibur to Poseidon's trident and anything in between. When you get the weapon, you automatically know how to use it and when you're done with the weapon, you can send it back to wherever it came from.
summary: The ability to summon any weapons use in any mythology
strengths: You can summon any mythological weapon
You automatically know how to use the weapon when you get it
weaknesses: If you take the weapon of a God they might come for it and destroy you

name: Legend's Armory
description: With this power, you can wield any weapon or magic object from myth and legend. You could summon Poseidon's trident to control water, or smite your enemies with Thor's hammer. You could summon a cloak of invisibility or a flying carpet. As you get more experienced with this power, the easier it is to control more powerful objects. With all the magical items in the myth of the world, the possibilities are virtually endless.
summary: The ability to summon objects from myth and legend.
strengths: Wield a variety of powers from different objects
No limit to amount of objects you can summon (even summon the Argo)
Could give allies objects that enhance their powers
weaknesses: Have to be able to control objects you summon
Can't summon creatures
Can't summon buildings

name: Divine Protection
description:
The Universe basically wants to help you. You will be protected from anything and everything. 

Bullets will miss. Knives will bend. Anything that wants to do harm to you will be prevented. 

Will not work if you tempt the power. You will die if you try to commit suicide.
summary: The ability to be protected by an unknown force
strengths: Someone up there likes you
Will protect you from unknown threats
weaknesses: Overprotection
No offensive ability
Will not protect you from yourself

name: Theatrical Instancy
description: With this power, when you watch a movie you have the ability to bring the characters to life to be your servants. If you want an army of 300 Spartan and the star wars republic army, and you watched there movie, you would be able to have them as your army. You can summon your favorite superheroes and villain to work together to do your bidding. You could watch the movie Superman with Superman. This power doesn't effect the movies from which you summoned the character.
summary: The ability to bring characters to life that you have seen in movies
strengths: You can get more than one movie involved in your creation
You can combine different movie characters into a more powerful being than in the movie
You can have the power of one character put into your own body
weaknesses: You can't use cartoons or animation in your creation
If you take the power of a character, you can't summon that character
You can't summon religious gods

name: Elemental Plane
description: With this power you gain a connection with an elemental plane of your choice. You can enter and exit the elemental plane at will and create portals to bring objects across. The elementals inside the elemental plane will not try to harm you but you will have to tame them to get them to follow your commands. You can also craft elemental artifacts while within the elemental plane. Lastly you will be able to use elemental magic that is connected to your elemental plane.
summary: The ability to have a connection to an elemental plane of your choice.
strengths: Able to open portals to enter and exit an elemental plane.
Have the ability to tame elementals and craft artifacts.
Can develope an ability to use elemental magic for the elemental plane.
weaknesses: Can only connect to one type of elemental plane and cannot change.
Have to be able to tame elementals.
Takes time to develope powers and craft strong artifacts.

name: Ability Manifestation Control
description: This ability allows one to control their ability in the way of how it emerges. There are many methods and ways an ability could manifest itself like through physical mutation, magic, interaction with a object/technology, or even through in enhancements. This ability makes the user summon their power through any of those methods or others. Since there are many methods, many abilities will be different. There is a time limit since you can only use one manifested ability at a time.
summary: The ability to manipulate how one's abilities manifest.
strengths: Access new abilities through different methods.
Having an adaption ability would be useful
weaknesses: Limited time use for each abiltiy
If you use the same method to manifest an ability, you only get the same ability as before.

name: Symbolic Clothing
description: It as it says on the tin. You can acquire powers based on whats on your clothes. Doctor Who:Time Lord abilities, Cross: angelic abilities, Money: Currency Conjuring etc etc. Iron-ons also included.
summary: The ability to have powers depending on the objects on your clothing
strengths: Shirt, Pants and Shoes can make powers
Clothes can be bought cheap
Iron-on's for pants and shoe decals even spray paint makes powers
weaknesses: No Shirt Pants or Shoes No powers
No money for clothes No powers
If you like plain T-shirts

name: Boomerang Touch
description: An object tagged with this ability will always return to you. The object will reappear in your possesion no matter where you leave it or place it. When it returns it may do so in several ways. It might reappear in your inventory or in your hands. If you own a house it may reappear there.
summary: The ability to cause any object to always return to you magically.
strengths: Never lose important object.
Objects reappear quickly
weaknesses: May be creepy to have an object constantly reappear near you.

name: Spirit Magic
description: Spirit magic is also called divine magic, depending on who is talking. Whatever the name, it is the act of channeling the power of a spirit to do great tasks. Some even draw a spirit within themselves, as this sometimes works better(and the spirit can speak to you and give you advice and knowledge). To channel or absorb a spirit, you must focus on everything around you, then a spirit will come to you and you can channel its power.
summary: The ability to employ spirit magic.
strengths: Can do almost anything, depending on the strength and power of the spirit.
Can even absorb a spirit (if they allow it) and gain their knowledge as well.
weaknesses: Spirit magic is a very misunderstood branch of magic, and is slightly hard to explain scientifically

name: Luck Enchantment
description: Every 24 hours you can enchant 1 person with good luck. Your power has an immediate effect, bringing something positive to that person's life within the minute. The duration of the enchantment is random, however, but lasts no less than one month. Each day, something positive is guaranteed to happen to the enchantee and no bad events relating to that person or their friends or relatives will occur. Of course, the definition of good luck is relative to the person being enchanted, so choose wisely.
summary: The ability to enchant yourself and others with long lasting good luck
strengths: Bless others with good luck and fortune
You can bless yourself to protect you and your loved ones
You will be seen as holy by some
weaknesses: Casinos won't be too happy to see you
You're not holy--it's just a sweet superpower
You'll never lose in a fight--luck will always be on your side

name: Children Of Magic
description: You are a Witch. You can use magic in almost any way you want such as elemental control, summoning, shooting lightning, making shields, ect. With magic the sky is the limit with all the things you can do. But the stronger the spell the more calories you burn. You can also see and communicate with ghosts. You can also know if someone has a superpower just by looking at them.
summary: The ability to use magic in almost any way you want, see ghosts, and automatically know if someone has a superpower
strengths: Control magic and do almost anything you want with it
You can know if someone has a power just by looking at them
Loose weight by using magic
weaknesses: If you use too much magic and loose too much weight you can die
There is a limit of power your spells can be
Whoever is editing this delete this and PLease DONT write something else in this slot

name: Movie Character Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character from any movie even if its a made for TV movie or a direct to video/dvd movie. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they may want to help you. When you're done with them you can send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon any fictional character from a movie
strengths: You can summon any character from any movie ever made
weaknesses: They are not under your control
They might try to kill you if its a villain

name: Bless This Mess
description: With this power you can increase the amount of lucky chances, coincidences, and miracles that occur in an area by how decrepit, polluted, and filthy it is. These lucky chances directly benefit any person currently in that area. The area can be as small as a cabinet or as large as a city, provided the vast majority of the area is dirty. If the area is improved, the excess luck goes away and return to a normal amount of luck.
summary: The ability to make an area luckier the more dirty and decrepit it is.
strengths: Be really lucky in dirty places.
Bless whole negiborhoods, towns, or cities that have fallen on hard times.
weaknesses: Blessing only works on dirty areas.
As such, your blessing will inevitable fade as the area is reinvigorated.

name: Manakinesis
description: Manakinesis is the ability to manipulate and affect the force of magic, and also prevent those with the magic-based powers, like Sorcery, to not harm you with their powers, this includes Spell based powers. This does NOT include manipulation over physical (genetic) or mental powers. i.e. having wings are physical, or telekinesis (mental). Manakinesis is not a magical power, it is a "-kinetic" based of power, that controls the force that allows those with magical based powers to work their magic.
summary: The ability to manipulate magic, and mystical power, and those who possess magical based powers.
strengths: You can lessen the effectiveness of a spell caster / mage's power by decreasing their access to the "mana force"
Manakinesis can allow you to tap into magical based powers, and use them.

If a magical powered person is prevented from using magic by another manakinetic, then you can counter that by giving that person the force that control magic, depending on how much stronger with the Manakinesis you are.
weaknesses: Manakinesis not being a magical based power, means another manakinetic can't be stopped by your power alone.
This power defines magical based powers as being influenced by a singular, natural force, that connects it with the super-powered universe.
Doesn't protect against physical based or mental based powers.

name: Genetic Skill Retention
description: This ability allows the individual to intuitively learn any skill after thinking about that particular skill, but only if their ancestors knew that skill. For example, if your ancestors were martial artists, and you happened to stumble upon anything related to that specific style of martial art, whether it be a word, a video, or a demonstration, you would instantly know how to use that skill.
summary: The ability to retain skills or traits from your ancestors.
strengths: You can intuitively know how to use any skill that any ancestor had.
You can learn multiple skills and keep them.
You can read a book and usually be guaranteed a new skill.
weaknesses: You can't receive skills from any relative in your generation (or further ahead).
People may notice if you just pulled a skill out of nowhere.
You may forget a skill if you don't practice.

name: Magic Minion
description: Every mage has their own minion. A minion (this is the most common name) is a being created entirely of magic. Depending on who created it, they will look and act differently from another mage's minions. The creator has complete control over them and can summon as many as they have the power for. The way the minions act and look like will depend on the mage's personality.
summary: The ability to create magical minions.
strengths: Can create an army of servants to do your bidding
They are based on your personality, so you're bound to like them.
They are always loyal to you.
weaknesses: Can only summon as many as you have the strength and power for.

name: Animate Art
description: The ability to breath life in to artwork,and summon it from the page it is printed on. This power does have a limit on duration, size, and quantity of summonings based on practice and natural skill. Animated works will take on a personality according to their appearance so, for example, you can't animate a caveman with the brains of Albert Einstein. The Artwork will be completely loyal to the Summoner and means of controlling the artwork are again determined by practice and natural skill.
summary: The ability to bring paintings and other artwork to life.
strengths: Being able to make up for physical shartcomings of the Summoner.
Able to adapt to different situations.
weaknesses: Having to carry/find artwork to animate.

name: Unconscious Invocation
description: This power means that when you feel in danger, a pysical projection of your subconscious will defend you in anyway. For instance, if someone is about to shoot you, a being that is the manifestations of your inner desire of self preservation will appear and protect you from harm. This thing can do just about anything depending on your strengh and bravery. You won't be able to use this ability at any other time than when you're in danger. This manifestation can look like an animal/you/whatever.
summary: The ability to summon a protective force when in danger
strengths: You'll be protected from anything/anyone.
No one will want to mess with you.
Having some feeling of security
weaknesses: If you have been knocked out, your power won't work
If you have been heavily drugged, your power won't work as well
Having doubts about your power won't make your chances of being saved high

name: Book Character Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character that's ever appeared in any fictional book (no biographies, encyclopedias etc. ) This power does not apply to comic books or graphic novels either. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they might want to help you. When you're done with them you can just send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon any fictional character from a book
strengths: You can summon any character from any fictional book ever written
weaknesses: They are not under your control
They might want to kill you

name: Doppelganging
description: Also called Doppelganger Generation or Doppelganger Summoning, this power can be used only to produce replicates of others. However, this is not a disadvantage; certain effects may be obtained by producing these replicates. Some can transfer their souls temporarily into the doppelgangers they generate, while others psychically command them. Some can even use the doppelganger to do damage too, which in turn harms the person the doppelganger resembles.
summary: The ability to generate copies of others for various purposes
strengths: Generate doppelgangers of others (three words: Angelina Jolie doppelganger) for your own purposes
If you psychically command the doppelganger, they can be directed telepathically/empathically
The doppelganger requires little effort to generate and/or disperse and last as long as desired
weaknesses: Only one can be generated at a time (have as many as you like, but they must come one at a time)
They may be kinda dumb (unless you can mimic and/or imprint knowledge as well)
They can be dispersed by others psionically

name: Super Power List Support
description: Summons a intangible goblin that can only be seen by you. The goblin has every power on the list but is unable to use the powers to affect the real world. The goblin must also follow any instruction you give him. The goblin is an expert on every power he possess so he can teach you to master any power you gain from this site. It is impossible for the goblin to break free from your control and cause chaos in the real world.
summary: The ability to summon a goblin that can teach how to use every power on this list.
strengths: Teaches to become a master in any power.
Visual aid and training programs for powers.
Free invisible / intangible goblin.
weaknesses: If you happen to get an annoying goblin.
Will look like youre talking to yourself. Can't have goblin train others.
May take long time to train to mastery.

name: Alternate Self Summon
description: This ability allows the summoner to summon alternate versions of themselves, the alternate versions have different powers due to the fact that their from different dimensions.
summary: The ability to summon alternate versions of yourself to aid you
strengths: You would be stonger in numbers
No one version has the same power, so variety
weaknesses: You wouldn't know if the alternate version is good or evil
Some powers might be lame

name: Construction Zone
description: This power allows you to create a zone with special rules inside. Inanimate objects inside the zone are prevented from breaking and become more sturdy. People inside the zone will begin developing limited alchemic powers that will allow them to use the resources around them to construct objects. The alchemic powers can change a constructed object into another as long as it is not dismantling the constructed object. One's alchemic powers are lost if one leaves the zone.
summary: The ability to create a zone that prevents destruction and allows creation.
strengths: Objects become unbreakable. (armor, buildings, etc.)
People can develop limited alchemic powers.
Allows construction of any type of man-made objects.
weaknesses: Rules apply to everyone until the zone is removed
Cannot break things even if you wanted to.
Living things are still breakable and alchemic powers cannot be used on living things.

name: Arithmancy
description: Arithmancers see the underlying numbers in everything. Velocity, Force, Length, Weight, Width- They see them all. They can easily divine where something will go, tracing the patterns of force and velocity. This makes them expert snipers, evaders and billiard ball players. Most of them are very good at higher mathematics, as well.
summary: The ability to see the numbers of the universe.
strengths: Predict the end location of most moving objects.
Easily determine the force and speed needed to hit or reach something.
weaknesses: Does not increase physical speed to allow you to dodge bullets.
Often leaves other people confused at the stream of mathamatics lingo they indulge in.

name: Angelic Blessing
description: After being blessed by an angel, you have powers typically reserved for angels. As you were born human (or elf, alien, or whatever), you look completely normal, and you can activate your powers. You have command over holy light, celestial fire, etc. but they're all holy because it's angelic. You can create wings made out of light, fire, etc. You can manifest any weapon made out of holy fire.
summary: The ability to have angelic powers
strengths: Any weapon you want made out of fire.
Wings for flight.
Can look completely normal if you want.
weaknesses: The more evil you are, the weaker you are.

name: Personalized Spellbook
description: This power gives you a personal spellbook that can never be stolen or damaged, and can be summoned and desummoned at will. It can also shift size and appearance at your will, though it always looks like a very old, dusty, leatherbound tome. Every day, you get a new spell, based on your desires and what you would want to do. As you grow older, the spells are allowed to be more and more powerful, and earlier ones can be beefed up. The book has unlimited pages, and opens to where you need it.
summary: The ability to summon a spellbook to give you magic power
strengths: You cast spells with a symbol, a word or phrase, or gesture, depending on the spell
OR, if you summon the book, you can cast it at will.
Build up a wide variety of spells to do things that are always cool (as it's your preference)
weaknesses: You aren't particularly potent at first
If you don't have a "gain permenant invulnerability spell", which would probably take YEARS to reach
Then you'll be at risk of being sniped or the like

name: Life Saver
description: If a person is dying, like truly dying, you can stop their death. Plus cure them of whatever was going to kill them. It works on yourself, but it takes longer. If you end up dying while that happens, you will end up as a ghost.
summary: The ability to save a person's life if they are dying.
strengths: Your loved ones would never die
You'd be a great cancer doctor
weaknesses: You might wind up a ghost

name: Comic Book Character Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character that has ever appeared in a comic book or graphic novel whenever you want. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they may want to help you. When you're done with them you can just send them back to whatever universe they came from.
summary: The ability to summon any fictional character from a comic book
strengths: You can summon any comic book or graphic novel character
weaknesses: They are not under your control
They might try to kill you if its a villain

name: Summoner
description: With the snap of a finger, you can summon any person or group of people to your location.  Just think of the person and snap your fingers.  Don't worry, you won't summon someone every time you snap your fingers--only when you want to use the ability.  And hey, if you don't know how to snap your fingers, then you'll suddenly know how!
summary: The ability to summon any person or group of people just by snapping your finger.
strengths: When someone wants to hang out, just summon them
Summoning the police or Jackie Chan if you're in trouble
Even better, summoning Chuck Norris if you're in trouble
weaknesses: You might find it funny when you're drunk to summon a crowd of angry arabs, which would be bad.

name: Summon: Images
description: The ability to summon anything from an image. Also has the ability to transfer images from one object to another. (Example: Moving an image from a photograph to your forearm. ) Also, during the transfer of the image, the summoner can change the size of the image.
summary: The ability to summon anything from an existing image.
strengths: Capable of summoning anything as long as you have a picture of what you want to summon
The summons last until they are unsummoned or destroyed
weaknesses: Need a picture of what you want to summon
Once the summon is destroyed, you lose the image and cannot summon it again without another picture
The more powerful or numerous the summons, the more physically tired the summoner will be

name: Angelic Possesion
description: You can have your body transformed into your angelic body that you get in the afterlife. Your senses will be sharper. You can fly (once you get used to your body). You will have superior healing abilities. Light will radiate off of your body or absorb into your body if you are evil. You can also see auras and detect whether a person is good or evil. You also get your soul weapon while in your angelic form. (see power Soul Weapon) In this form, your wings are your weak spot.
summary: The ability to take the form of your individual angelic body
strengths: Superior senses, healing abilities, and you can fly. You can only be killed by decapitation
You can detect other angels based off of their glow. You can also detect good and evil people
You can revert back to your human form when you wish
weaknesses: Your wings are very vulnerable to getting hit. It feels like you got the wind knocked out of you
The deeper the wound, the longer it takes to heal
Just because you can heal doesn't make you invincible. The more you are hurt, the slower you are

name: Video Game Character Summon
description: With this power you summon any character from any video game (Mario, Pacman, Derek Jeter) or App (The Doodler, Red Angry Bird, Om Nom) whenever you want. The characters are not under your control but depending on who you summon they may want to help you. This power also works for athletes who've appeared in sports video games. When you're done with them you can send them back to their home universe.
summary: The ability to summon any fictional character from a vido game
strengths: You can summon any video game or app character ever created
weaknesses: They are not under your control
They might want to kill you

name: Monospecies Omnipotence
description: When you get this power, you think of a single species of animal. You have complete control over this species. You could gain its attributes, turn into it, turn individuals of it into humans or human/animal hybrids, turn humans into individuals of it, give others its attributes, mind control it, spawn/summon it, destroy it, give people were-it powers or curses, edit attributes of individuals (only within the bounds of the species, though). Any animal-related power you can think of.
summary: The ability to completely control one animal species
strengths: Get a large variety of powers AND the ability to grant powers to others
Of course, the animals (of this species... ) absolutely love you and follow your orders
So you can keep them as pets, too, and impress people
weaknesses: One species. You can't change the basic form of the species, either, you're stuck with it.
Thinking of a relatively useless species
You still can't, say, travel through space, teleport around, reshape matter, etc.

name: Neutral Matter Manipulation
description: What is "Neutral Matter"? It is matter that is found between the Matter/Anti-Matter worlds. It is immune to the effects of both of two matters. The user can summon it from its own reality to control it. This matter is only good for defense, because Neutral Matter will repel itself and any other matter. It cannot touch Matter/Anti-Matter nor they cannot touch it. The user can touch.(Warning: This is Babeltalk's version of what neutral matter is?)
summary: The ability to summon and control neutral matter.
strengths: Control a new kind of matter and you can summon the energy of that world as well.
Have a powerful defense
It is immune to the effects of both Matter and Anti-Matter
weaknesses: Maybe something outside the realm of science like magic can defeat it.

name: Compassionate Gaze
description: When someone commits such an atrocious and vile and corrupt deed, that many could consider unworthy of forgiveness, and they show no sign of remorse, guilt, or any attempt towards redemption. You can gaze upon their soul and fill their hatred, and loathing with true compassion for their victims and the crimes they committed against them.
summary: The ability to gaze upon a soul who has committed a heinous act, and fill their heart with compassion.
strengths: Bring out a redeeming quality in some of the most heinous villains, for the atrocities they've committed.
You would instinctually know when someone holds no remorse for an ill-deed committed, so this power can't be misdirected.
weaknesses: This power is very specific, and purposeful, and would hold no value in a majority of super-powered contexts.

name: Pan Dimensional Teamwork
description: If you have the Pan-dimensional Existence power, then this power will let you call up to five of your other dimensional selves to work together as a team with you. This power will make them work together, no angelic version of you fighting a demonic version of you. This power will keep your team in this dimension for as long as you like. You can swap out team members at any time. A kystian version of you for a sharke version of you. A sharke version for an infinity dimension version of you.
summary: The ability to summon up to 5 of your other dimensional selves.
strengths: So many dimensions, so many possible team combos.
weaknesses: It will take time to learn which team combos work and which don't.
An amoral way of thinking may be the only one to have the best team combos.

name: Astral Being
description: When projecting your physical body and conscious mind go comatose. Your astral body is able to interact with things in the ether: spirits, living auras, divinities, and other astral bodies. The form you take changes with personality, morality, and force of will. Astral bodies are tethered to their physical bodies and their purpose for entering the ether by a silver cord. It takes years of practice to create distance between bodies, impose a clear goal, or act in the physical realm.
summary: The ability to become concious of your astral body and project from your physical body.
strengths: Request aid from ghosts, gods, and other astral beings.
Influence decisions and life forces of living beings.
Bring your astral body into the physical realm with enough practice.
weaknesses: Leaves you highly physically vulnerable.
You might not remember what you were supposed to do in the ether.
Actions you take might attract unwanted attention from higher powers.

name: Necromancer
description: Necromancy is the magical art of rasing the dead. With this ability you can animate corpses and skeletons, see and talk to ghosts, and use your power over death in many ways. All corpses and skeletons you animate are under your control. And while they do have their own will, ghosts will usally do as you say. They can move things, phase, turn invisible, and use other ghostly powers. You can also sense when people you know die by reading their life forces.
summary: The ability to control the dead, death, ghosts, ect.
strengths: Can control corpses, skeletons, and ghosts
Ghosts have many powers and are usally obedient
Already being dead, corpses and skeletons can't die
weaknesses: Kinda a freaky power
Knowing when a friend or family member will die just sucks
You will be naturally feared

name: Sanctum Sanctorum
description: You become the mightiest magician in the cosmos, a Sorcerer Supreme, just like Stephen Strange/Doctor Strange, and thus on level with cosmic entities. You gain mastery of magic and genius-level intellect.
summary: The ability to become one of the Sorcerers Supreme
strengths: Become one of the mightiest magicians in the cosmos
Mastery of magic and genius-level intellect.
On level with cosmic entities
weaknesses: Dependent on magic, sucks if foes are immune to it
Have to find ways to indirectly affect magic-immune foes
Not being able to handle so much power

name: Super Person Copy
description: Any super-person from a TV show, movie, book, comic, etc. , the user can pick one, and have all their powers. The super-person can be anything/anyone that has superpowers (alien, mutant, magician, creature, hero, villain, etc. ) But, the user can only pick one super-person, that's it. But the good part is the user get's ALL of that super-person's superpowers.
summary: The ability to possess the superpowers of a super-person
strengths: Have all the powers of any super-person
Super-person can be an alien, mutant, magician, creature, hero, villain, etc. (superpowers required)
weaknesses: User can only pick one super-person.

name: Vicarious Superman
description: This is a sinister version of the Superman Spell. You transfer your mortal limits into any person, place, or thing you desire. By getting as far away from them as possible, you become a powerful demigod, but you will start to lose your powers in their presence. If the vessel is damaged, you will be as well.
summary: The ability to transfer your mortality into an object and become a demigod.
strengths: Be a god among men
Any limits you have will be transferred to the vessel
weaknesses: Your vessel is your kryptonite
If it is damaged, you will be as well

name: Spirit Shifting
description: The ability to become a ghost at will. When user becomes a ghost, their body turns into an object (example: necklace. ) When they want to be a mortal again, the just have to touch the object. Spirit-shifters can become ghosts at any time, but they can only stay ghosts for short periods of time (about 30 minutes. ) If they stay longer, they be taken to the spirit world.
summary: The ability to become a ghost at will
strengths: Can go through objects
Can communicate with ghosts (to get information)
Can easily spy on people
weaknesses: Shifting forms requires lots of concentration
If their object is lost, so is their human body
If they stay a ghost too long, they get taken to the spirit world

name: Hallucagenic Lygotation
description: Creates darkness around a person, making the world seem "pitch black." They then are haunted by their worst fears. The caster may use it on more then one person if they have enough training using it. The victim will die if killed by a hallucination. (They will die in the way the hallucination kills the victim. Only way to stop this power is by having Telekenetic powers, or to reverse the casting.)
summary: The ability to create an overwhelming darkness that brings out a person's worst fear, making them hallucinate.
strengths: Easily trainable.
Manipulative.
Great for super villans
weaknesses: Unstable at times.
The power can be reversed.
You cannot move while casting.

name: Astral Shape Shifting
description: The person changes into ALL supernatural forms of life. The user can turn into a ghost or spirit (without experiencing death) to explore the Spirit World and come back to the normal world at will. The user can also transform into the spirits of the Elements. The user can also become an angel, a demon, a grey spirit and (temporarily) an Immortal being that can shake hands with Deities. Commonly the ones who practice "Spiritual Converse" (strongly enough) are more likely to receive this gift.
summary: The ability to transform into ALL forms of spirits
strengths: The user can be a source of vast energy to living things and the Elements.
The user can receive knowledge and more powers from these realms.
If the person is powerful enough, He/She can take a spirit of the deceased back to the normal world.
weaknesses: It drains the user's energy (temporarily). And they lose more body mass.
The realm of Elemental spirits and nature spirits is very hard to get the hang of.
If the user dwells too long as a spirit, the physical aspect fades away and will never come back.

name: Gift: Summons
description: Basically, someone with this power is better at using summoning powers than other beings. Thus their summoning powers are better than most other being's powers and it is harder to unsummon their summoned beings. However, someone with this power can only recieve summoning powers, nothing else.
summary: The ability to be gifted at summoning powers
strengths: Almost no one is as good at summoning as someone with this power.
Summons are harder to undo.
weaknesses: Can only have one gift.
Two beings with the same gift will cancel out the unsummoning aspect.
Pretty much restricted to only summoning powers now.

name: Librarian
description: Can summon any book to hand that person is aware of- has either seen it, knows specifically what it's called or what it is. Can also choose to return or keep the specific book after summoned.
summary: The ability to instantly summon any known book to hand
strengths: Instant source of information
More robust books can be utilised as a weapon in a pinch
weaknesses: Limited to the books the person is aware of
Limited help in dealing directly with villans

name: Demonic Immunity
description: This power grants you total immunity and protection from that which is demonic or infernal. They cannot directly affect you in any manner. When they try to use their powers on you it does no damage. This also allows you to ignore the affects of any demonic weapon or magic that is used against you. You can defy demonic or infernal contracts and protections that you come by and can easily harm the strongest of demons. Even if your life depended on them you could continue to live.
summary: The ability to be immune to that which is demonic or infernal.
strengths: You do not have to fear harm from demons or infernal creatures.
Provides mental protection from demons and infernal beings.
Your soul cannot be taken by them.
weaknesses: They can harm you with regular weapons like guns.
You can be affected indirectly.
No protection against that which is not demonic or infernal.

name: Artifact: Imperium Graphices
description: When you say "Adeat", a drawing pad and a magical feather pen appears. Whatever you draw instantly comes to life (such as birds, pillows, people, televisions, etc. ). The more detailed your drawings, the better they will be.
summary: The ability to bring your drawings to life.
strengths: Can use your drawings as shields or decoys.
Can summon weapons or shields.
Can summon things to fight for you.
weaknesses: 1% of the damage your drawing takes goes to you.

name: Beast Soul Bind
description: Imagine, you're standing under a huge mountain and you have to get to the top. And as you wonder how to get to the top, you see an eagle fly to the top. You place your fists on each other and look at the desired beast. All you need to do now is say Bind. Light will shine from your eyes. And now you are able to do all this beast is able to do but don't take it's form. The bind is broken after 3 hours or when you bind with an other beast. Side fact you also gain all knowledge of this beast.
summary: The ability to summon the soul of an animal to aid you.
strengths: Be the worlds best animal therapist.
Bind with cereberus and gain 3 heads... Thrice the brainpower and firebreathing powers
Binding does not cause any physical side effects when it's about to be unbound.
weaknesses: Try to be near the ground when 2 hours and 59 minutes have passed and you are bound with a bird.
If you bind with a very small animal such as insects, you risk getting a resize.
Binding might cause some mental issues, such as thinking you are the being you binded with.

name: Genie Summon
description: With this power you can summon a genie. The genie is under your complete control until it grants you three wishes after it does that the genie disappears and you have to wait a period of 365 days until you can use this power again. There are a few restrictions regarding what you can wish for, you can't wish to have super powers, for more wishes, for somebody to fall in love with you, to become a god, to become a genie or for somebody to die.
summary: The ability to summon a genie
strengths: You can summon a genie.
It will grant you any three wishes.
weaknesses: Once it grants you three wishes the genie disappears and you can't summon a new one for a whole year
You can't wish for more wishes.

name: Alter Angel
description: Each & every living being has 2 images of himself: his physical image & his alternative image. This ability allows you to shift into your alternative image or angel form. Angel forms are naturally empowered: flight, phasing, weapon projection, enhanced physical abilities & limited elemental control. Wings are optional. Angel forms always have platinum hair so you can't go unnoticed anywhere at all, so for your own safety you can't stay in angel form forever & normal weapons can still hurt you.
summary: The ability to shift into angel form at will
strengths: Be a hero... Or not
Ultimate seducer
Unstoppable
weaknesses: Super strong but not invincible
Always draws attention... Being too perfect has its downsides
Uhm... Being an angel doesn't mean you will go to paradise (if that place really exists)

name: Angelic Presence
description: Anyone you encounter will be calmed/fascinated by you and believe that you are an angel. Also they will welcome you into their homes as they will believe that it will bring them good luck.
summary: The ability to have a presence that is angelic
strengths: You may not have any enemies, just people who want to gain your favor.
People may think you're good, even when you're not.
weaknesses: Someone has to know you really well in order for this power to not affect them.

name: Call Of The Guardian
description: A spirit, usually a type of demon, when called upon takes a physical form and aids you in battle. The spirit can have two physical forms. For example, a wolf demon will have the form of a majestic powerful wolf, and a cute cuddly puppy form.
summary: The ability to call upon your guardian spirit.
strengths: Aids you in battle
Is bound to you for life
If your reincarnated, it will take a new form too
weaknesses: You to are bound to it, therefore you feel its pain if its hurt
Only have one guardian

name: Magic Garnet Summon
description: This ability allows you to summon an ancient magical garnet necklace, that gives powerful magical abilities to the wearer. The garnet gives the wearer the ability to summon crimson energies that can be formed into different constructs. It also gives you the ability to transmute anything into garnet, or to summon large amounts of non-magical garnet out of nowhere. Only the pure of heart can use the magic. You can make the necklace disappear at any time.
summary: The ability to summon a garnet necklace that gives the wearer magical powers.
strengths: Summon a powerful magical artifact.
It grants the user many powers.
Only the pure of heart can use it.
weaknesses: You could lose it.
Only one garnet necklace at a time.

name: Nephilim
description: The Nephilim, also known as the "fallen ones", were the offspring of fallen angels and humans. You are capable of utilizing any powers or abilities your ancestors may have had. These abilities may refer to the natural elements, spirituality, and magic. Although you are not a full-blooded angel, you are still quite powerful.
summary: The ability to inherit the powers of your angelic relatives or bloodline.
strengths: Easily vanquish foes with rays of light.
A fearsome warrior in strength, speed, intelligence, and endurance alike.
Wield enchanted swords imbued with light or darkness.
weaknesses: You are only half-angel.
You do not possess wings, your flight is limited and is considered a glide.

name: Gifting Or Giving A Gift
description:
The limits of this ability are not known. With this ability you can give any man woman or living creature any thing they desire from immorality to flight. 
in order to gift or bless someone a payment must be made to you. Payment can be what ever you choose such as a piece of paper. Or money. Or even the individuals soul
summary: The ability to bless or gift anyone with any gift he or she desires
strengths: You will be loved by everyone you bless or gift
weaknesses: You can not give yourself a gift.
All though. You can requre as payment the individual to give the gift back to you at anytime you
Choose allowing you to aquire said gift

name: The Paths Of Magic: The Wizard
description: The Path of the Wizard, or the Path of Will, is the first of the five paths of magic. Wizards are mages that use nothing but will to do magic. Naturaly, wizards are the most powerful of mages, due to the fact that they are almost all-powerful and are only limited by imagination. Very few have the power or the talent necessary for wizardry. This ability grants you a special talent for wizardry.
summary: The ability to have special talent for wizardry.
strengths: Wizardry will come easily to you.
Almost no limits.
weaknesses: Cannot break the universal laws

name: Own The Spear Of Destiny
description: He who holds the spear of destiny holds the fate of the world in his hands. Owning the spear causes you to fall into positions of high power, and have fate make you incredibly lucky and immortal for the duration of your ownership. Notable users include: Longinus - a roman soldier who used it to pierce Jesus and caused him to die; Peter Bartholomew - used it to summon an army of angels and won a battle in the 1st crusade; Hitler - used it to gain political power and nearly conquered the world.
summary: The ability to control the fate of the world
strengths: You gain positions of power very quickly, most of your goals succeed
Fate will protect you, assassinations will fail, you will escape danger, you won't ever get sick
Anyone you impale with the spear will surely die, it pierces all forms of armor and metal.
weaknesses: If you lose the spear, you die.
The spear chooses its owner. The spear can choose another and leave you any time
You will be long remembered, for good or bad.

name: Curse
description:
You can place a curse on whatever you wish (people, places, objects, etc. ). How you do it (eye contact, rhyme, etc. ) and what the curse can do is up to you as long as it is not benevolent in nature (like giving people good luck) and brings harm to others. 

While your curses will not end with your demise, you do need to include a way for people to break it. Just as you decide the effects of your curses, you can also decide how they can be broken.
summary: The ability to lay a negative effect upon whatever you desire.
strengths: Versatile
Coming up with a good curse can be an art itself
Curse people who slighted you
weaknesses: Limited by your own imagination
People will probably hate you when they find out you cursed them

name: Chaos Reincarnation
description: Legend has it that King Solomon sealed up 72 powerful demons so their strengths cannot be put to misuse. These demons has a strict ranking and almost all has a small army collected from hell. These demons will obey your orders, although some of them may be very unwilling. To learn more about these demons, consult this link: http://en. M. Wikipedia. Org/wiki/Lesser_Key_of_Solomon
summary: The ability to summon one of the mythical King Solomon's 72 Demons under your command.
strengths: These demons each has magical powers and unique personalities.
Better yet, you have 72 to choose from.
You may summon up more than a single demon at once.
weaknesses: Some of these demons can get a bit out of hand. Try not to make them mad.
Manipulating these demons require some mental and physical energy. Overuse may cause extreme strain.
To use efficiently, you need to learn and remember all 72 demons.

name: Dimensional Doom Mirror
description: This ability summons an empty 500 meter dimensional sphere that creates a copy of anyone or anything trapped in it. The copies possess all of the abilities and physical attributes of the original. The only thing that differs between original and the copy is that the copy is mindless and its actions are guided by the user to mimic the actions of the original. If for any reason the original and copy collide with each other both will be deleted in mind, spirit, and body.
summary: The ability to summon a sphere that creates copies of everything in it
strengths: The abilities of the original and the copy will cancel out each other
Only the user of this ability is exempted from its rules
Uses the ability or actions of the opponent against them.
weaknesses: If the copy and the original touch, both are annihilated

name: Intangibility Immunity
description: This ability is good when fighting ghost or things that can phase through stuff. The user are able touch intangible beings. They can hit anything that is made up of an element that can't be touch like fire, light, and even darkness. With turning, the user can make his other abilities be able to hit or affect intangible things.
summary: The ability to be able to touch spirit, or intangible beings.
strengths: Be able to touch intangible beings
Be able to hit Intangible beings
Be able to use other abilities to hit or affect intangible beings
weaknesses: None for the time being.

name: Enchantment
description: Have you ever seen a movie where the wizard has a charm that protects him from harm? That charm was enchanted. With this power you can do the same. You can control magical properties like luck, protection, obedience, bad luck, balance, and many others. You can enchant anything or anyone. And you can control how long it lasts.
summary: The ability to create and control magical properties
strengths: You can control tons of properties
You would have luck,balance,protection and much more.
You can enchant people
weaknesses: If they find out people might want you to make them charms
Not much use with fighting

name: Summon Perfect Contract
description: With this power you can summon a contract for any situation that will not have any loopholes unless you want them to exist. The contract will cover all possible outcomes, even those that you could not think of yourself, to ensure that you get exactly what you want when the contract is signed. When a person signs the contract they must follow the contract exactly and will forced to obey the contract through multiple means. The contract can not be changed at a later date.
summary: The ability to summon a contract for any situation.
strengths: The contract automatically covers any loopholes the person signing could use.
The contract is perfect and automatically has sections for every possible outcome.
Once signed the contract must be obeyed by the signer.
weaknesses: The contract can not be changed at a later date.
The contract could possible affect you as well depending on the deal.
Must get person to understand and sign the contract out of free will (no telepathy etc.)

name: Purifying Blood
description: Your blood can purify whatever it touches whether it is a demon, fallen angel, weapons, etc. It will purify both physically and spiritually.
summary: The ability to purify anything by touching it with one's blood
strengths: Churches would love to have you join for purification rites.
Always have clean water.
weaknesses: Churches could reject you and call you blasphemous.

name: Spirit Manifestation
description: This ability grants the user control over their soul to bring forth their spiritual self as if it was their clone. Everything you can't do, your spiritual self can. And with proper training, the user will become able to create more, at least 2 clones, 3 max.
summary: The ability to bring forth your spiritual embodiment.
strengths: Can create spirit clones of yourself. (Maximum limit is 3. )
Everything you can't do, your spirit can, such as fighting, cleaning, cooking, etc.
You'll never get beat up. (lol. )
weaknesses: You have to train yourself to create more clones and to give them your features and qualities.
(Some may think of this as bad. ) You'll hardly ever have to do anything.
If your spirit self gets killed, then so do you because it's a copy of your soul. So your soul dies.

name: Forced Sight
description: You can force other people to see the spirits of those that they have killed. The person can also feel anything that the spirits do to them, but they cannot do anything to the spirits themselves. You can also see and communicate with spirits who really want you to help them get revenge on the one who killed them.
summary: The ability to force others to see the spirits of those that they have killed
strengths: Hurt other people with this power by using the spirits of those they killed.
Can possibly always have someone to talk to.
weaknesses: If the other person hasn't killed anyone.
Can only communicate with spirits who really want your help.

name: Summon Intangibles
description: This power lets you make orange, green, purple, or white spirits. They can vary in apperance from cute chibi ghosts to menacing spirits. They can have a variety of abilities from consuming negative emotion to haunting people. You can make a large number at a time and they can change in size and shape.
summary: The ability to create spirits, ghosts, ghouls, wraiths, and intangibles for many uses.
strengths: Summoning intangible beings
They have abilities.
weaknesses: Can still be defeated.
They have a free will (although they will listen to you)

name: Historical Help
description: This power allows you to summon historical figures and groups to help you. You can call on people like Attila the Hun, George Washington, Napoleon, and their soldiers to fight your foes. But you aren't limited to summoning an army. The people you summon can also teach you. Learn magic from Houdini or strategy from Alexander the Great. Be taught by ninjas, knights, Roman legionaries, and more to master combat, stealth, survival, and countless other skills.
summary: The ability to call on people from history to help you
strengths: Summon a small army to overwhelm opponents
Receive training from history's best
Get answers to history's mysteries
weaknesses: Ancient weapons not always a match for modern ones
Might not be real effective against some super-powered opponents
Have to know your history

name: Ankh Of Ascendance
description: A person who is in possession of this mystical Ankh of Ascendance will be granted a myriad of magical and mythical abilities to be used. When combined with the scepter of knowledge, the user's power is doubled as well the user inheriting all the knowledge of all the scepter's previous users
summary: The ability to be granted magical and mystical powers by the mystical ankh of power
strengths: You are one of the most powerful magical users on Earth.
weaknesses: If the Ankh is separated from the user, the user will gradually lose their power.
Certain mystical artifacts can block the user's connection to the Ankh's mystical energies

name: Geas
description: You have the ability to place a Geas upon anyone that asks for it. A Geas is an unbreakable vow that is both a blessing and a curse. As long as someone follows their vow the Geas empowers them. The effect stacks, so someone who has sworn many Geas will receive more power than someone with only one. But if you should ever break any of your Geas (accidentally or otherwise), you will wither away and die a lonely, ignoble death.
summary: The ability to swear people to unbreakable vows
strengths: Place people under a Geas and empower them.
Use it to help people trying to break a bad habit.
weaknesses: You can not place one upon yourself.
You may only place a Geas on someone if they swear an oath before you.
Fate seemes to love getting people to break them.

name: God Phone V2
description: With this power you can summon any of the Roman Gods or Goddesses. When you summon them they are not under your control but if you have a good enough reason for summoning them they might help you. On the other hand if you don't they might destroy you.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Roman Gods or Goddesses
strengths: You can summon any of the Roman Gods or Goddesses
They might help you if you have a good enough reason for summoning them
Just having a god near you is enough to scare your enemies
weaknesses: They might want to destroy you for summoning them

name: Cobalt Mistress
description: You can summon a silver-grayish ancient coffin to have them trapped and vulnerable inside of it, while creating floating glowing cosmic latte spikes & nails you can turn your back as you snap your fingers and have them come down on the opponent with the first twenty-four and the last one hitting before the tomb shatters.
summary: The ability to enclose your opponent in a tomb and impale them.
strengths: Can be fun thing while torturing your foe.
weaknesses: None.

name: Magic Lamp
description: What more is there to say? You can ask any wishes you want, except having more wishes, being omnipotent, stuff like that.
summary: The ability to have a magic lamp with a genie inside it who can grant you 3 wishes.
strengths: We're not in Disney Land, you can also kill people, resurrect them, or make someone love you.
Even if you can't ask to be onmipotent, you can ask to have one specific power.
weaknesses: You have only 3 wishes...
And you can't ask to have as many wishes as you want.

name: Altdimension Creature Summon V2
description: With this power you can summon creatures from alternate dimensions. When you activate this power you receive knowledge of all of the alternate dimensions and the names, powers and descriptions of all the creatures residing in all of those dimensions. All you have to do then is say the name of the creature and the dimension the creature is from and it will appear. It won't however be under your control. When you're done you can send it back by saying the name of the creature and the dimension.
summary: The ability to summon creatures from alternate dimensions
strengths: You can summon creatures from different dimensions
weaknesses: The creatures are not under your control

name: Ring Of Solomon
description: (This ring is most prized among rings) the wearer of the ring has the power to summon any demon and enslaves them. You have an unlimited supply of demons to summon and enslave
summary: The ability to summon and enslave demons
strengths: Army of demons
Build and destroy cites
Command demons to submit to you
weaknesses: Every demon hates you
You will lose the ring eventually
People will kill you for the ring

name: Mirror Veil
description: Using this power, you can create mirrors whose perimeter and area are dependent on your skill and general power. Most people can manage a four or five foot mirror. These mirrors are easily enchanted - more so than normal mirrors - and reflect light and most magic perfectly.
summary: The ability to conjure reflective surfaces of glass in a radius depending on your power.
strengths: Mirrors confuse people, especially in the dark.
A light manipulator may get toasted by his own beam if you 'outdraw' him.
The mirrors are permanent, and could be a source of income.
weaknesses: The mirrors are fragile and melt from enough non-magical heat.
You have no control over them once you create them.
Someone whose power includes them could use them against you.

name: Xiaolin Showdown Throw Down
description: The ability to summon various objects is no joke. Especially THESE objects. One with this ability has the power to summon any of the Shen Gong Wu from the series Xiaolin Showdown. In addition, you have perfect knowledge of their names and their functions, so you never summon the wrong one. You effectively have the potential to be a very powerful warrior, for either the side of good or for the side of evil.
summary: The ability to summon and properly use all of the Shen Gong Wu from the TV series, Xiaolin Showdown
strengths: Perceive the name, appearance and use of all the Shen Gong Wu
Summon any of them, and have heightened skill in using them
At the higher bands, replicate the objects and construct new Shen Gong Wu of your own
weaknesses: At the lower levels, you can't summon more than one at a time
At the lower levels, have a harder time perceiving and recalling the Shen Gong Wu
Shen Gong Wu can be broken (you can only fix that at the higher levels)

name: Protective Blessing
description: With this superpower, you can bless others with protection from one harmful event of your choosing. The blessing lasts indefinitely and the event can be anything from being shot, a car accident, or getting sick. It's important to note that the blessing acts as a preventative measure. Being blessed AFTER the fact won't help any current situation. Also, only the latest blessing is active. Blessing against being cut is allowed, but that would prevent helpful surgical procedures, so bless wisely!
summary: The ability to bless people with protection from harm.
strengths: Protect your loved ones (and yourself)
No fear of skydiving--just bless yourself from falling injuries
weaknesses: One blessing at a time
Choosing the wrong blessing

name: Guardian Angel
