name: Blessing Of Hades
description: Hades is the Greek god of the dead, and of wealth. His blessing allows you to summon the dead and shadows to do your bidding. Skeletons and corpses will be your army.  Shadows will be your armory, your pets, and you highway. You will be able to travel through shadows. The other side of his blessing is wealth. Precious metals will be your play-things, able to be controlled, heated and reshaped to your will.
summary: The ability to have the blessing of Hades.
strengths: You can control the dead and shadows
Shadow traveling is almost like teleporting
You'll be rich beyond your wildest dreams.
weaknesses: Shadow travel makes you very tired. You can only do it twice every few hours.
Forging shadow creatures and precious metals is very hard to do. It will take practice.
While you're very powerful, your powers drain you a lot

name: Cryptic Helper
description: With this power, a mysterious, disturbing and shadowy human(? ) figure with glowing red eyes that only you can see appears occasionnally before you and then quickly disappears. It will give you a hint about your future by performing a relevant action that may or may not make sense at first by either gesturing, miming, pointing at something or presenting an object inside its hands. That figure tends to appear more often when you're in real need or in danger or when destiny needs your hand.
summary: The ability to receive hints about the future from a mysterious figure.
strengths: Although frightening, that figure will always try to help you out in its own way.
Be warned about impending danger on you or people around you.
Whether you turn good or bad, the figure will always follow your alignment.
weaknesses: You will most likely think you're crazy when you first experience this power.
So will people around you.
Passive power. You can't stop the mysterious figure from appearing.

name: 4 Kings
description: The Four Kings are the opposite of the Four Horsemen; you can summon them to bring light & hope all over the universe. For example: Blessing (Health) is the opposite of Pestilence: can cure anyone of diseases, Peace the opposite of War: become blessed & stop ongoing conflicts, Bounty is the opposite of Famine - can have the power to create crops & stop anyone from starving, and Life the opposite of Death: allows you become merciful and to bring back the innocent from the dead.
summary: The ability to bring about the bringers of absolute harmony.
strengths: Can bring about the goodness everywhere.
weaknesses: None actually.

name: Ghostly Haunting
description: Ghostly Haunting is the ability to enter someone else's mind and change what they see into their worst fears. An example is projecting visions of spiders everywhere for a person who is scared of spiders.
summary: The ability to haunt a person with their worst fear.
strengths: You can easily distract someone.
People may be crippled by the fear.
weaknesses: People probably won't like you.

name: Soulless Immortality
description: If you have this power you are immortal but you somehow lost your soul and are still alive. One side effect is that you are unaffected by soul-based powers but you can't use soul-based powers either.
summary: The ability to be immortal but at the cost of one's soul
strengths: Any power that affects souls no longer has any effect on you.
You can't die.
weaknesses: You lost your soul.
You can't use soul-based powers.

name: Dark Angel Summon
description: With this power you can summon an angel of darkness. The angel is not under your control and is completely evil. It will probably try to take over your mind and use you for its own agenda so you should probably get some kind of anti mind control powers before using this. The angel is extremely powerful with flight, super strength, immense knowledge of black magic and shapeshifting abilities. You can unsummon it later.
summary: The ability to summon an angel of darkness
strengths: You can summon an extremely powerful dark angel
It can be mind controlled
You can send it back whenever you want
weaknesses: It might try to mind control you or kill you

name: Spirit Mastery
description: The ability to call upon spirits through the use of summoning them. They are bound to their summoner and will do their bidding . They can be used as both an offensive and defensive power.
summary: The ability to call upon spirits and control them
strengths: Awesome defensive powers since they cannot be dispelled
Their loyalty to the summoner is unwavering
They can be summoned from anywhere
weaknesses: It takes great concentration to summon them
If concentration is broken during summoning, they disappear
They are not as strong in daylight.

name: Induced Excitement
description: With this superpower, you can make anything (or any subject) sound exciting to you and others. You can make history sound exciting to you. You can get someone excited about watching paint dry. Only you can see the exclamation points. This is also useful in combat. You can make your enemies excited about the good side. It's these invisible exclamation points you summon that makes things exciting. Effects last 24 hours or less. Exclamation points become more and more visible after the first hour.
summary: The ability to make anything sound exciting to you and others!
strengths: Make anything sound exciting to you and others!
Make your enemies excited about joining the good side!
Make people excited about making a better future!
weaknesses: Making people excited about bad things.
Exclamation points start to become visible after the first hour.
Effects wear off in 24 hours or less.

name: Egyptian Gods: Meskhenet
description: The Egyptian goddess Meskhenet was said to be the creator of life. She was able to breathe "Ka" (life spirit) into a human's soul as they are born. Users will be able to ccreate life and spirits, breathe life spirit into nonliving objects, and resurrect dead organisms for a short period of time. As Meskhenet was also associated with fate, users will be able to manipulate and sometimes foretell the future.
summary: The ability to create life and spirits.
strengths: Give life to nonliving or dead things.
Manipulate and see the future.
weaknesses: This power is extremely costly in energy.
Resurrected things are short-lived.

name: Old One Power: Necronomicon
description: Old Ones: things of science and magic from other realities merged in hyperdimensional forms that bring insanity to all who merely think about them. Malevolent or uncaring, the human race is beneath the notice of their infinite might. You get an encyclopedic knowledge of these beings: the names, histories, abilities, politics, philosophical insight into their existence, the ways to summon them, and call upon their power for your own use. You are forced to write as much of it as you can in a book.
summary: The ability to have the forbidden knowledge of the mythos
strengths: Not even the Old Ones have all this knowledge. If you're noticed, they might find it useful.
Of course, you can also use it to avoid them, staying alive as long as possible.
You know how to call upon their magic for nearly any purpose, and their cults will love you.
weaknesses: Being around even the friendliest of the Old Ones will corrupt you or slowly kill you.
So does using their magic. Also, their cults are NOT good people. Heroes will assume you're evil.
You must complete that book. When it is, you must either accept the corruption, or die by your hand.

name: Angel Power: Angel's Sword
description: This power allows you to channel the mighty sword that every angel wields. At will, you can call to your possession a mighty, three-and-a-half-foot-long sword. This sword can not only cut through anything, but it can change into any type of bladed weapon: two-handed broadsword, longsword, shortsword, dagger, throwing knife, hunting knife, shuriken, butter knife, whatever. In fact, if you need it to, it can even turn into a shield of the desired size, to protect as well as attack.
summary: The ability to channel the sword of an angel
strengths: Sword can cut through nearly anything (and can be recalled to your possession at will)
Can change to a sword or bladed weapon of any size (to fit one's personal strength, or preference)
Can also change into a shield of any size, and (when developed) even armor
weaknesses: Can't cut through divine materials (can't pierce the robe of an angel, or similar materials)
If you try to use it to harm an innocent, it'll phase through them (then teleport away from you)
If you try to use it against an angel, the sword will teleport from your possession to the angel's

name: Mediumism (Mediumship)
description: Also called Spirit Channeling, one with this ability (called a medium) has a fine tuned connection to the spirit world. They can see and sense the spirits of the deceased, understand their speech, communicate with them (regardless of language barriers) and even channel them into one's body; channeling spirits allows them to express themselves through the user, including speaking/writing, as well as using any superhuman powers they may have had in life (this is called Mediumistic Automatism)
summary: The ability to perceive, communicate with and channel spirits of the dead
strengths: Perceive, and communicate with the spirits of the deceased (and perhaps other spirits over time)
Channel spirits of the dead (give them a chance to communicate with loved ones)
Allow them to work through you, to use any superpowers they may have had in life
weaknesses: Does not prevent the possibility of being possessed
Does not ensure a spirit you channel is a good one (once they take control, they leave on their own)
Does not let you compel spirits (only perceive, communicate with and channel them)

name: Ability Linking
description: The powers are not fused together. They are just "tied" together, so if one is copied, stolen, cancelled, removed or deleted, the other will be as well. You can only link your own powers together, including those which didn't originally belong to you. Curses can also be linked with another curse or ability. Objects with abilities cannot be, except if they are part of an ability the user has, like the ability to own or summon the object. If a power is immune to an effect, the other will be too.
summary: The ability to link together two or more of one's own superpowers.
strengths: Link a curse to one of your superpowers and tempt someone else into stealing or copying it.
Link Ability Cancellation or Superpower Dispersal to a superpower someone wants to steal from you.
Positive effects are shared too, such as power augmentation.
weaknesses: You need to come up with a good strategy if you want to make this power useful.
The superpowers are not fused together and can still be used separately.

name: Magic Immunity
description: One with this ability has a natural capability to resist and shake off all magical effects; this means that no magic can affect you at all. Magic energy directed at you will bounce off of you; magic items will malfunction; magic bindings and magic traps will be treated as intangible around the user, and he can simply walk through them. Magic cannot be directly used on the user in any way, shape, form or fashion
summary: The ability to not be affected by magic, in any manifestation
strengths: No magical attacks, entrapment, banishment or curses/hexes/jinxes
No being altered magically
Makes the battle an even playing field when up against mages
weaknesses: Mages REALLY don't like you
Can't be magically ENHANCED either
Can't be magically HELPED OUT either

name: Ghost Force
description: This power let's you see ghosts and attack them. Instead of going through the ghost it is like a solid to you.  When in use the body glows a faint greenish-blue. Also allows you to turn a spectre or poltergeist back to visible form.
summary: The ability to be able to attack a ghost as though it were solid and return them to normal form
strengths: You can attack ghosts as though normal solid creature
Allows you to turn poltergeists visible
Blocks most ghost powers that are sent as an attack at you
weaknesses: Only applicable to ghosts

name: Under Pressure
description: This power is both a blessing and a curse. Whilst it allows you to send pressure shockwaves and implode/explode enemies, it comes with a price. You will forever have the song "Under Pressure" by David Bowie and Queen blaring at you and all those in your vicinity at 80db. A small price to pay? Perhaps. But remember.  "It's the terror of knowing What this world is about Watching some good friends Screaming 'Let me out' Pray tomorrow - gets me higher Pressure on people - people on streets"
summary: The ability to manipulate pressures, and send pressure waves at people.
strengths: Awesomely powerful ability with the power to kill.
weaknesses: You have to listen to "Under Pressure" forever.

name: The Dorian Gray Complex.
description: Not to be confused with the Dorian Gray Syndrome, the user of -this- ability can place their soul into an object and therefore become immortal, so long as that object is not harmed and/or destroyed. The user thus retains their prime appearance and is enhanced to peak human conditioning. The user can also separate their soul into multiple objects, making their destruction incredibly difficult -- the user is still unaffected even when many portions of their soul has been dissipated.
summary: The ability to cast one's own soul into objects.
strengths: The user is immortal.
The user is enhanced.
weaknesses: If the object is damaged or destroyed, the user suffers the same fate.

name: Witch Time
description: This power is more like a magic spell. Whenever you dodge an attack (or anything that's going to hurt you) at the last second, time automatically slows down.
summary: The ability to slow down time after dodging at the last second.
strengths: Enemies would be moving in slow motion to you.
Enemies would think you have super speed.
weaknesses: You can't control it. The time slow-down happens automatically as soon as you dodge.
Dodging at the exact last second isn't easy.

name: Spiritual Purification
description: We all know that there are some real creeps out there: rapists, pedophiles, criminals, devil worshippers, etc. This power enables the user to purify a person's spirit. Turn some child molester into a dedicated catholic or something. Or even something small, like turning a bully into a "sweetie." But maybe, if someone was pure evil, this power would either purify them--or destroy them.
summary: The ability to purify anyone's spirit
strengths: Lower population of creeps, criminals, and bullies
If anyone tries to do anything bad to you, just purify them and they'll stop
weaknesses: Can't attack, just defend

name: Kigen Arts
description: This ability allows one to borrow and reshape the spirit of nature. The spirit can take any form, offensive and/or defensive means, under your command. Using this ability may corrupt your spirit and cause you to lose control over your ability.
summary: The ability to borrow and reshape the spirit of nature
strengths: Can resurrect the dead by transferring the borrowed spirit from nature.
You can create a barrier or pure blast of spiritual energy.
weaknesses: May corrupt your spirit and cause you to lose control over your powers
Overuse of this ability may anger nature, resulting in violent weather

name: Curse Eater
description: A demon, human, or other entity with the Curse Eater power would be able to absorb any harmful magic that is fixed to a location, phrase, event, or otherwise tied down to a condition. The entity would then be able to use the power they gained from their meal for magic.
summary: The ability to devour curses for their magical power and use it as a spell.
strengths: Most people avoid curses, so you live without that hanging over your head.
Magic not specifically directed can be devoured to fuel your own spells.
Even a normal person with the Curse Eater power could be an extraordinary sorcerer.
weaknesses: You would gain enemies - enemies that are probably sorcerers or divine beings.
A sorcerer with Curse Eater would find that it stunt their magic growth.
People might think you're weird if you stalk around asking for rumors about the local haunted house.

name: Full Metal Alchemists: Truth
description: One with this power is able to summon the gate of truth and go through it, going through the gate of truth allows one to do alchemy without use of transmutation circles, one who practices this ability could also be able to perform alchemy without even movement. Just thought.
summary: The ability to be able to summon the gate of truth.
strengths: Perform alchemy without circles.
weaknesses: The truth isn't always good.
You see terrible memories once you walk through the gate.

name: Spell Cutter
description: Someone with this power can cut spells into pieces (thus preventing the spell from being cast) with any bladed item. Spell strength does not matter as the spell is negated. A holder of this power can tell that a spell is being cast because they'll see a design appear near the spellcaster. Cutting the design prevents the spell from being cast. The design is what represents the spell and size and elegance differ dependent on the magnitude and complexity of the spell.
summary: The ability to prevent spells from being cast with ordinary bladed items
strengths: Works with any blade.
Works on any spell.
weaknesses: Requires a blade.
Only eliminates spells, magic that isn't formed into a spell isn't affected by this power.
Power only works before the spell is cast not after.

name: Dive Breath
description: This power allows you to give others the power to breathe underwater. Although the effect is temporary and fades after a while. The user must first breathe into the desired person's mouth for effective use.
summary: The ability to give others the ability to breathe underwater
strengths: You and others can breathe underwater
You can endow multiple people because it's temporary
Good for scuba diving trips
weaknesses: Power is temporary and will wear off after 4 hours
Must breathe deeply into the target's mouth
Only works by breathing directly into the target's mouth

name: Art Resurrection
description: Any thing on paper or on another surface can be turned into life. You can make it any size. Draw something bring it to life. Sculptures or 3d solid figures DO NOT COUNT.
summary: The ability to turn any drawing to life.
strengths: Your imagination is your power and no matter how cartoon the drawing is, it comes out realistic
endless possibilities. dinosaur. gun. mountains.
You are are never alone in battle or at home. Draw a soldier, a friend or a pet.
weaknesses: You need a drawing or else there is no superpower.
Can not bring 3d figures such as toys to life.
If want to bring something to life like a tiger or person, you need to be a good drawer.

name: Name Claircognizance
description: You know all of everyone's names from first, middle and, last to online names, aliases, and nicknames. You know the pronunciation and spelling, as well.
summary: The ability to know everyone's name
strengths: Never awkward if you don't remember someone--all you need is the name to make it look like you do
Can pretend like you know the bouncer to a club and convince him to let you in
Rumpelstiltskin has nothing on you
weaknesses: People may think you are a stalker
Kids may think you are Santa Claus
You don't know if the nickname was nice or mean

name: Inner Darkness
description: This power is rare to find, because there are a few conditions that must be met, at least one. (Either one: A person must have been possessed by a demon and survive, two: the person must confront with his/her inner demon through insanity, or three: the devil gives the person this power before the day they were born.) Once you activate it, you will transform into the demon made by your own darkness, depending your personality. The demon will destroy what causes you misery and woe.
summary: The ability to transform into your inner demon.
strengths: You'll be immortal until the person's life and goal meets a happy life.
You'll gain the basic powers of strength, speed, etc. As yourself.
You'll be able to use the Shadow Abilities.
weaknesses: Once you turn a hundred years old, you will lose your powers, die, and umm... Go to hell. (sorry)
When using this ability, you'll lose all consciousness untill the inner demon is done.

name: Cash Extraction
description: Conservation of matter prevents matter from being created or destroyed. But that's no problem for you! With this power, you can "create" any amount of cash (in your physical possession), but this cash is randomly drawn from the possession of others. Let's say you draw $100. A $100 bill might come from a high roller in Vegas, or five $20 bills might be plucked from the wallets of 5 high schoolers. With practice, you can hone in on a specific area, and with mastery, on a specific person.
summary: The ability to summon any amount of money, but it's randomly taken from other people
strengths: Virtually unlimited cash
You can finally graduate from the dollar menu
Become the Robin Hood of the 21st century!
weaknesses: You can't control who the money is taken from without a great deal of practice
The denominations are left up to chance (you might get $1 bills, or $100 bills)
At the root of this power, you're stealing from others, making you a thief

name: Wish Granting Rituals
description: You know a variety of magical/mystical (or sufficiently advanced, if you're a science type) rituals which you can use to imbue objects with wish-granting power or spirits. Oil lamps, monkey paws, and wells are the most common, but you can do it with just about anything. However, the rules and potency varies on the object and ritual: Lamps might have faithful and nigh-omnipotent spirits, but an unbreakable limit on the number of wishes. Paws have a malleable number, but the wishes are corrupt.
summary: The ability to know how to create wish-granting objects
strengths: You can vary up the rules a bit (but there is almost always a limit on the wish number)
Wells/fountains can grant infinite wishes (with a coin, at least), but they need to be REAL ones
You can make wish-corrupting curse objects and give them away
weaknesses: The ritual must be perfect- any slip will cause a demon that auto-corrupts all wishes
Can not re-use an object that is used up. If you use a lamp, after three, you need a new one
Your creations, and even you, will be the most coveted things on the face of the earth

name: Split Persona
description: This uniqe ability allows the user to let out two sides of his/her personality, each with powers of their own that represent that side of the personality. For example, the dark side could have powers like super strength or super senses.
summary: The ability to let out your light side and your dark side
strengths: Your light side makes a great companion and friend
Each side has its own powers
weaknesses: Your dark side might be hard to control
You can only let them out and back in or in other words no powers for you

name: Dovahkiin
description: With this power you can absorb dragon's souls to make your self more powerful. You can learn dragon words of power to unleash a mighty thu'um or dragon shout. Each shout has 3 words of power to it
summary: The ability to be the dragonborn of legend
strengths: Great at slaying dragons
Can unleash massive power
No telling how powerful you might become
weaknesses: Dragons try to kill you alot
Might hurt friends and or family with some of your thu'um's
Some people will fear you for your power others may abuse you for it if your not careful

name: Summoning To Powers
description: You will be able to turn powers that allow you to summon persons, into powers where you gain their abilities instead. This effect can be reversed.
summary: The ability to change a person-summoning power into a ability-gifting power
strengths: Gain the abilities of the beings you wanna summon.
weaknesses: Cannot acquire powers of summoned objects.

name: Broken Summoning
description: With this power you can cause anything to appear right next to you as long as you are already holding a piece of it. So you can cut a part of off somebody's wallet and then make it appear right next to you and take their money. Or you can cut off a part of your enemy (a nail or a hair, or a hand or something) and stand next to a jail cell so the enemy will appear in it.
summary: The ability to cause any object appear right next to you as long as you have a piece of it in your hand
strengths: You can cause anything to appear right next to you as long as you are already holding a piece of it
You can do it as many times as you want
weaknesses: You have to be holding a piece of something for this power to work

name: Indignation
description: "I, who stand in the full light of the Heavens, command thee, who opens the Gates of Hell. Come forth, divine lightning! This ends now. Indignation." - Jade Curtis. Divine lightning that obliterates almost any opponent. The only thing able to to stand up against Dhaos, the Time Traveler from Derris Khar'lan! Can be light, lightning, or wind elemental. Many ways to obtain, may need to contact the Summon Spirit Luna, or learn it yourself by studying magic.
summary: The ability to call down the lightning of the gods.
strengths: Jade Curtis the Fonologist - Most famous user of Indignation
Genis Sage the Genius Mage - First to upgrade Indignation to the powerful Indignation Judgement
Rita Mordio the Blastia Weirdo - Most recent user of Indignation
weaknesses: Mithos Yggdrasil - Evil angel, instigator of a gynocidal hallocaust. Also uses Indignation Judgement
Neblim the Teacher - Replica of the powerful fonologist Neblim, user of every form of Fonology.
Dhoas - Can only be killed with Indignation. He fights with DHOAS LASER.

name: Love Seat
description: With this power you can cast a spell on any chair/couch/bench/stool so that when somebody of the opposite gender as yourself sits in it they instantly fall in love you even if they've never met you before. It only works on people of the opposite gender as yourself and you can only make them fall in love with you.
summary: The ability to cast a spell on any chair/couch/bench so that when somebody sits in it they fall in love with you
strengths: You can make anybody of the opposite gender fall in love you
weaknesses: Only works on chairs/benches/couches/stools
Only works on people of the opposite gender
You can only make them fall in love with you

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Thrones
description: The Thrones, also known as the Ophanim, are the manifestations of justice and righteous authority. Their appearances were rather strange and otherworldly, unlike the other angels. They appear as beryl-colored wheel-within-a-wheel, their rims covered and speckled with hundreds of eyes.
summary: The ability to become a bizarre-looking angel of justice and authority.
strengths: Harness the power of justice and authority to your own extent.
Utilize rays of light and purification to instill justice
As any angel, you are capable of taking on the form of a human or a beast.
weaknesses: None really.

name: Cursing
description: When you use this power, the target's worst case scenario will happen.  The result varies between people depending on what their worst case scenario is.
summary: The ability to create the worst case scenario for any person of your choosing.
strengths: Revenge
weaknesses: Absolute power may corrupt you

name: Military Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any vehicles used by an military. You are also give the knowledge on how to operate the vehicles. You can unsummon them when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon any military vehicles
strengths: You can summon any vehicle used by any military
You know how to operate the vehicle
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: The vehicles can be destroyed or stolen from you

name: Card Stack Abilities: Mask
description: Normally when you access the abilities of a spirit, you can only use a small percent of your potential. The Mask ability allows you to draw out more of your powers. There are several mask levels. After the second level you could choose to become the Spirit you possess, and take on some of its personality. You can also merge your own spirit with the mask in order to make a more powerful form.
summary: The ability to create a spirit mask for greater power access.
strengths: Greater access to your powers.
Take on a spirit form while using the power
You can chnage your body shape depending on level of power and type of spirit.
weaknesses: You may lose control when experiencing heavy emotions
People with the Card Stack Ability: Jester are not affected by your powers
Con 2 is only valid when they are of an equal of higher power level.

name: Mahoujutsu: Angel's Shadow
description: One of the two paths of Mahoujutsu. Instead of selling your soul for immense power, you become the 'Shadow of an Angel. ' You keep your soul and gain power and defense, but not as much as if you became a demon.
summary: The ability to become a shadow.
strengths: Boost of strength.
Boost of defense.
Keep soul.
weaknesses: Not as strong as demonization.

name: Astral Trapping
description: Trapping foes in an astral-projective state implies the following. You can keep ghosts from manifesting on the physical plane. You can immobilize ghosts in one place on the astral plane. You can keep people from turning intangible, keep the intangible from becoming tangible again, and keep the invisible from becoming visible. Prevent Astral Projection, and travel to the Astral Plane. Prevent a spirit from leaving a person's body (they don't die)-- you can even do the same for YOURSELF.
summary: The ability to trap foes in an astral-projective state
strengths: Spirits can be trapped on astral plane, kept from manifesting on physical plane
People who can turn imperceptible (invisible or intangible) are trapped in that state
Prevent Astral Projection (and spirit departure upon death), Astral Travel and Ominous Presence
weaknesses: People who are stuck being invisible can still affect you
Doesn't have too much combat use
Ghosts get really pissed at you (so when you let down your guard, they will let you have it)

name: Monetary Penalty
description: This power allows you to "curse" someone so that, whenever they perform an act of selfishness, greed, or ill will the "price" of the damage caused by their actions vanishes their assets. If they do not have the money to cover the damage, then assets such as vehicles and property will vanish. If they do not even have those things their organs will be vanish based on their current value on the black market to cover the "dept. " If even that does not suffice they will vanish entirely.
summary: The ability to have money and assets vanish in response to ill deeds done.
strengths: Give someone an incentive to do good.
Punish anyone who makes their money by mistreating others.
weaknesses: The assets vanish, they don't go to the wronged party.
Could destabiliz economies.

name: Artifact Of Light: Aero Dagger
description: Aero dagger is designed for tricking people. It is impossible to kill someone with it, because as it touches someone, it teleports them to a pre-set location, replacing them with an identical clone created by the dagger. This allows you to publicly kill someone, while actually teleporting them to safety.
summary: The ability to summon a magical dagger with black blade.
strengths: Good for tricking people
The dagger can't actually kill anyone
weaknesses: Careful not to use it on someone you dont want to die, if the location is set to be inside a volcano

name: Haute
description: Hautes are a type of magic users. Once they have gained control over an ability, they can both recognize and manipulate that power of themselves and others. Manipulation includes keeping the other person from using they're power, amplifying another persons power, or unlocking another person's innate ability if it has not "awakened".
summary: The ability to recognize and manipulate powers of others, as long as you have them.
strengths: Any power you have can recognized and manipulation, even in others
You can "awaken" dormant powers in others if you recognize the power they have
weaknesses: Requires strong will to use, as you need to override another's willpower

name: Shelter Summon
description: With this power, you can summon a shelter in your presence. It can be unsommend when your done with it...or you can just let it exist
summary: The ability to summon a shelter your presence.
strengths: Always have a place to stay.
weaknesses: It's only a cabin with little to no furniture.
Basic amenities, such as a toilet, sink and tiny fridge

name: Hydra Summon
description: With this power you can summon the multiheaded hydra. The hydra is under your complete control and you can make it do whatever you want. If the hydra dies, you lose this power forever. Unless you are somehow able to bring the hydra back to life with some sort of resurrection power/machine/spell/other. When you're done with the hydra, you can send it back to where it came from.
summary: The ability to summon the hydra
strengths: You can summon a hydra
It is under your complete control
weaknesses: If it dies you lose this power

name: Pocket Change Summoning
description: With this power you can summon anything of equal or lesser value to the amount of money you have on your person. You don't lose the money when you use this power and you can easily summon multiple things that are worth the amount of cash you have on you but you cannot summon anything that would cost more than the money you have on you.
summary: The ability to summon anything that you could afford with the money in your pocket
strengths: You can summon anything that would be able to afford with the money you have in your pocket
weaknesses: You can't summon anything that is worth more than the amount of money you have on you

name: Delete This Take No Prisoners
description: You do your usual victory pose. Then your eyes will turn red-orange and you rushingly glide towards your opponents. Next, when everything goes dark, you perform multiple blows to everyone at the same time, ending with your opponents on the ground and you'll utterly whisper "Serer Tong" which is an anagram for No Regrets.
summary: The ability to rush towards, and inflict multiple blows on multiple enemies at one time.
strengths: Comes in extra handy when you are outnumbered.
Can say Take no Prisoners in a different language.
weaknesses: None.

name: X Treasure Chests V2
description: With this power you can cause a chest full of treasure to appear whenever you write or draw the letter x. It can be in any color and the larger the x the larger the treasure chest. You can draw the x on any flat surface and a treasure chest will appear. You cannot get rid of the treasure chests.
summary: The ability to make treasure chests appear whenever you write or draw the letter X
strengths: You can make treasure chests appear just by writing or drawing the letter x
It can be in any color
The bigger the x the bigger chest
weaknesses: You cannot get rid of the chests
You have to draw an x

name: Bringer Of Magic
description: Whenever someone with this ability is around anyone doing magic or using a magical power, they would find that they have up to 10 times the power they did before. This is a voluntary ability, so if someone is using a magical power against you, you can turn it off. Also, you choose who you use your power on. So if there are two magically powered people--one friend, one foe--you can choose to only power up your friend. Can also be used to overpower someone to the point where they pass out.
summary: The ability to amplify any sort of magic
strengths: Voluntary ability, so no powering up an attacker
Can choose who you amplify
Can be used on yourself if you have another magic power
weaknesses: If you don't know about someone, you might power them up by mistake
Might knock yourself out

name: Kill Yourself And Be A Ghost
description: With this ability, you can kill yourself by force of will. You will fall on the floor and your spirit will leave your body BUT you won't go into the light. From this point, you are an earth-bound ghost, and you're existing on another plane. Now you're made out of energy, and you can put yourself into anything, objects, animals and even humans. When you possess them, you can control them, though you have to practice. You can communicate with other spirits too.
summary: The ability to kill yourself and become a ghost and return later to your body to live again
strengths: Communicate with other dead people, interact with other energies and expand your knowledge.
Haunt places, scare your enemies and friends!
Possess objects and control them
weaknesses: Be sure to hide your body before activating the power, otherwise you might wake up in a coffin!
You have 24 hours, after that, your body starts decomposing, and you'll be taken to the afterlife
Avoid mediums if you don't want to be seen

name: Debt Collection
description: A person with this power has the ability to collect any debt, and the debtor cannot attack you or they will owe you more. Killing you lets you take their life. This can also work on other, non-monetary types of debts. For example, if someone agreed to give you their soul to pay for the debt it's fair game. All the things you collect from debts can be loaned to others. Debts must be agreed on ahead of time and there is no joking. If someone is unable to pay on time, you can change the conditions.
summary: The ability to collect any debt no matter how ridiculous and be totally invincible against a debtor
strengths: You always get back what you are owed
You can collect people's souls--and sell them to others
You can write the contract for the debt yourself
weaknesses: If you aren't a loan shark you probably will become one
If someone decides to kill themselves to end the debt--can't collect
If you owe someone a debt this power will work against you too

name: Pan Dimensional League Of You
description: Have the PD existence power and you can create a pan-dimensional league of yourself. You pull every other you to this dimension. All of you will get along by varying degrees. The demon you will apologize to the angel you and that will be that. The kystian you will be insanely hateful as normal but will take it out on anyone who isn't a version of you. Bad guys watch out. You will likely need your own planet, a transdimensional building or a private dimension as a base of operations.
summary: The ability to create a mixed villain/hero/antihero league of yourself.
strengths: Create the Power League of (insert name here).
Better than a team.
weaknesses: You need vast space to house every version of yourself.
You'll have to hire a PR firm to deal with the carnage caused by the kystian you.

name: Dor Mii
description: You will become a a demon in the form of your spirit animal; for example if your spirit animal is a fox you gain a demon form of a fox. You also gain powers that correspond with said demon as well as increased speed/strength/agility and heightened senses. While this power is normally voluntary, a transformation can be caused by extreme emotions such as rage/fear and love. An involuntary transformation will also occur is your life is in danger.
summary: The ability to become a demonic representation of your spirit animal
strengths: You will be stronger than you were in every way
The only people on your level would be strong demons and other Dor Mii
Depending on what your spirit animal is you could become unstoppable
weaknesses: A transformation caused by rage could send you into a killing frenzy
You will be able to hear and smell everything and that could get annoying
Rare though it may be you could develop a demonic influence that could corrupt your soul

name: The Pied Piper Effect
description: When one plays a musical instrument, they can attract rats in a 100 mile radius to the area and control them. The control of the rats will wear off once the user stops playing an instrument. The rats follow you wherever you go playing an instrument. This works with any musical instrument, not just a flute.
summary: The ability to play a musical instrument to summon and control rats.
strengths: Rats have strength in numbers and diseases.
Call upon rats to attack your enemies.
Call upon rats to assist you in times of need.
weaknesses: You have to have musical talent to use this power. (Vocals don't count)
You can't keep playing an instrument forever.
If there are no rats in a 100 mile radius, the power is useless.

name: Divine Form: Osiris
description: A priest of Osiris can temporarily allow the Egyptian lord of the dead Osiris to posses their body. This grants all the powers of the god for a short period of time (undead army, resurrection, etc).
summary: The ability to temporarily channel the spirit of Osiris into your body
strengths: Temporary invicibility
Near indestructibility
Incredible powers
weaknesses: Leaves you completely drained, physically and mentally
Cannot hold on to the spirit for long; your body cannot hold divinity for too long
Have to be in peak human condition or may be fatal

name: Death's Angel
description: Whenever you look at someone you can see how much time they have left in their eyes.
summary: The ability to see the time of death for anyone
strengths: Have to look someone directly in the eyes
Can know the deaths of some people you dislike
Can prevent those deaths if you're powerful enough
weaknesses: Can know when someone you love dies
Need to look directly in the eyes

name: Native American Magic
description: Native American Magic was the form of magic used by the natives of america, up until Columbus came. They knew that everything in nature had a soul or spirit. They figured out how to converse directly with that spirit. This allowed them to control the paths of rivers, the rocks of mountians, and the branches of trees. They also could communicate through smoke, creating shapes and images out of the smoke.
summary: The ability to employ Native American Magic
strengths: Conversing with spirits of nature around you.
EVERYTHING in nature has a spirit, even things like fire.
Controling smoke
weaknesses: Just because you can talk to the spirits, doesn't mean you can control them.

name: Divine Immunity
description: This power will let you live however you please. You will continue to exist without being under divine or godly influence and control. If you were made by a god or goddess, you can continue to exist without them and they cannot exert any control over you (force you into an afterlife of their choosing or something). You are even immune to diseases started by godly entities. However, this does not change the fact that you cannot kill a god or creator without the appropriate powers.
summary: The ability to be immune from any divine or godly power, good or not.
strengths: Free from divine influence.
Includes other deities than just the Mythpowers, such as the Nordic gods.
You can live your life as you please, no worries about karma, Judgment Day/Ragnarok etc.
weaknesses: Demons are not included.
The gods might like you but can't help you.
Floods and other phenomena could still affect you indirectly.

name: Slavery Immunity
description: Someone with this power cannot be the slave of other beings of its kind, gods, demons, angels, animals, spirits, etc. Slave is defined by this power as being forced to work with no pay (being given food for work does not count as pay). If one is already a slave when they gain this power it does not activate until after they are freed.
summary: The ability to never be a slave of any being in existence
strengths: Freedom! Unlimited freedom!
weaknesses: Already a slave? Have to wait until you're freed.
Can still be a servant.

name: Myth Power: Psyche's Smile
description: Psyche (Psykhe), in Greek myth, was the goddess of the spirit and the soul. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive and communicate with spirits (as well as perceiving souls of the living) at will. In addition, one can see into the astral plane at will. One can also release and return his soul at will (Astral Projection). Furthermore, one can pass between the material and astral realms at will (Astraportation). One can even psychically perceive, communicate with and command lepidopterans.
summary: The ability to channel Psyche's command over the essence of the spirit and the soul
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with and channel spirits; perceive the souls of the living
Psychically perceive the astral plane, project one's consciousness to it or travel through it bodily
Psychically perceive, communicate with, share senses with and command butterflies and moths
weaknesses: Cannot evict souls by touch (Astral Eviction) until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot absorb evicted spirits to gain knowledge, skills and abilities until the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Arrows of Eros and MythPower: Thanatos' Embrace provide immunity (NCN)

name: Army Of Anubis
description: (This power is cool but creepy) you have to sell your soul to Anubis to get this power. Anyone that kills you gets control of the army. You don't have a soul. Your life is increased. Your true master is Anubis
summary: The ability to command the army of Anubis
strengths: Your the general
Make any army carer in fear
Sweat revenge
weaknesses: You have to sell your soul to Anubis ( no con negation)
Anyone how kills you gets control of the army ( no con negation )
Anubis is your master

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Virtues
description: The Virtues, also known as the Strongholds, are responsible for supervising heavenly bodies in order to ensure the cosmos remains in order. The Virtues are renowned for their powerful nature and astonishing might. These celestial beings appear as having a pair of diamond-studded wings, ceremonial robes, and ranging from six to seven feet in height.
summary: The ability to become an angel of divine supervision.
strengths: Imbue within your foes "natural order", bringing them to your side.
Skewer through targets with your diamond-studded wings.
Incinerate targets with raw cosmic energy.
weaknesses: Virtues have no key weakness but are still vulnerable.

name: Summoning Tome
description: The oddest thing about this power because it's corresponded to the various types of objects and/or weapons summoned from the netherworld, Example - if you use a katana, a demonic samurai come out and slices an ememy. the second example is if you use a coin, a vere crazed Angeldevil comes appears and attacks an evildoer. Be warn to use this ability wisely.
summary: The ability to call fourth random apparitons, various type of objects & weapons are summoned from Heck.
strengths: Might come in handy when you use small or large weapons.
weaknesses: Use one object or a weapon at a time.

name: Forced Power Usage
description: With this power you can cause any superhuman or magical being within a forty mile radios to use their powers/magical abilities. This can be useful if you see somebody in danger nearby but can't save them yourself you simply cause another superhuman to use their powers to save him/her. You could also cause people to reveal their secret identities by causing them to use their powers in public areas. Or if you're a villain you can cause heroes to destroy things and be shunned by the public.
summary: The ability to make people use their powers
strengths: All of the pros are mentioned above
weaknesses: You don't chose how the person uses their powers

name: Majora's Masks
description: This power alows you to magically have any of the 24 masks you would like(except Majora' mask) from the game The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask and use its power (if it has any).
summary: The ability to conjure and use the masks from Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask
strengths: Magically conjure any of the 24 masks.
Use mask abilities such as transfromation and marching.
The masks look awesome!
weaknesses: Certain masks have no point other than looking awesome.
Some effects last very short periods of time
Some undersireable effects (such as being loved by the undead)

name: Delete This Blessing
description: double
summary: The ability to be a double
strengths: be
weaknesses: superfluous

name: Divine Transformation
description: When you use this power it transforms the target based on how well they have treated others. If the target has never been nice nothing will happen, but if they have always treated others with kindness then they will gain extreme beauty, powerful healing abilities, and angelic wings. Those who have been both kind and mean will get weaker versions of the previous powers dependant on how nice they have been.
summary: The ability to transform someone based on how well they have treated others
strengths: Can reward the kind and good.
The recipient will look like they are good now, if they didn't already.
weaknesses: Not based on karma so even those who seem evil could be boosted.
Target may not be thankful.

name: Life Force Drain
description: You can Drain People 's life forces but only people you hate.The life force you drain can be used to create spirit minions with the same power as you.
summary: The ability to drain the living daylight out of people you hate
strengths: You Can Drain People's Life Force
You choose who to drain
You can Create SPirit minions that will do anything you want
weaknesses: You'll feel weak when you create spirit minions
Your Powers Can Only work to the people you chose to hate
You'll Faint or Have Blackouts When The life force is not fully drained

name: Myth Power: Charon's Conscience
description: Charon (Kharon), in Greek myth, was the ferryman of the dead into the afterlife. As such, channeling them allows one to psychically perceive, communicate with, summon, banish and ward off the spirits of the dead, at will. In addition, one can make physical contact with said spirits of the dead, at will. Furthermore, one can psychically teleport onto a ferry that travels to the Underworld, at will. One can even withstand  death/underworld/afterlife-based effects, as well as spiritual possession.
summary: The ability to channel Charon's command over the essence of spirits' entrance into the afterlife
strengths: Psychically perceive, communicate with, summon, banish, ward off spirits (ghosts) at will
Make physical contact with spirits; psychically teleport to a ferry to the underworld, at will
Withstand Death/underworld/afterlife-based effects (and Spiritual Possession)
weaknesses: Pro #1 and Part 1 of Pro #2 do not apply to demons until developed (NCN)
Cannot perceive whether subjects are destined for Heaven or Hell, by touch, until developed (NCN)
MythPower: Hades Haunt and MythPower: Persephone's Poise bypass Pro #3 (NCN)

name: Plastic Demons And Spirits
description: With this ability you can mold any plastic thing into anything and then transfer almost any demons or spirits to make the molded objects come to life and improve the plastic by turning them into the element of the spirits or demons that posess them and if more then one spirit or demon is transfered to one object than said object will keep the first spirit or demon element.
summary: The ability to both control, mold and transfer demons and spirits into plastic objects.
strengths: You can build an army of plastic demons and spirits.
You can transfer up to 16 spirits or demons into a transformed plastic object to boost its power.
You can help the envirement by collecting plastic.
weaknesses: You can't transfer demons or spirits that posess the fire element.
Some of the spirits and demons might turn out useless or like destruction to much.
If you join a spirit and a demon in a transformed plastic object the object will self destruct.

name: Summon Ally
description: You have the power to summon a magical orb right near your ally where ever she/he is. You don't need to know their location.   The ally can be a friend, a relative or anyone who's not an enemy.   That ally has the choice to touch the orb, or not.  And only the ally can see it.  The orb shows a view of the destination place.  (so they can see it's safe)  The moment the orb is touched that ally will then immediately appear at the place that was shown through the orb.
summary: The ability to summon an ally
strengths: Have your allies appear near you when needed
Summon your kidnapped relatives to a safe place
weaknesses: When your ally can't even move enough to touch the orb
When your ally is sleeping and isn't aware of the orb
Friends that are constantly late for a meeting and keep demanding you help them.

name: Doom Kiss
description: You kiss somebody. Then you are able to decide when that person is gonna die. Can be instant or undefined. You can decide the moment of death even years late as long as you remember the person and know why you want them to die.   Doesn't apply to vampires, ghosts, or any form of undeath.
summary: The ability to determine the remaining time a person has to live when you kiss them
strengths: Nobody can ever cheat on you
Nobody would suspect you
It gives a very rich RPG plot twist
weaknesses: You can kill your lover by accident in a moment of wrath
You'd need to kiss your enemies(or someone you don't want to)

name: Demon Eye
description: With this eye you are able to perform feats only capable by a demonic presence but is limited to the user's own spirit. Ex; see a person's soul or past, predict future, enhanced strength and agility, etc.
summary: The ability to enhance senses to demonic levels
strengths: Knowing you try to do good with something evil
Having the strength to stand against anything
Everyone knows about you
weaknesses: People fear you
You are always alone
Cannot control your own power

name: Spirit Immunity
description: Spirits such as ghosts, brownies, boggarts, poltergeists, etc can't affect you in any way but demons and angels still can.
summary: The ability to be immune to the actions of low- and moderate-ranked spirits
strengths: Demons can still be blocked with 'Infernal Immunity'.
Angels can still be blocked with 'Divine Immunity'.
Having this power prevents ordinary spirits from possessing you.
weaknesses: You need other powers to make you immune to higher-leveled spirits (No Con Negation).

name: Witch Species: Cunning Folk
description: The cunning folk livid in anchient britain, mainly in ireland, they had abilitis such as, healing others, seeing the future, levitation, seeing spirits and demons, minor kinetics, and influenicng the weather
summary: The ability to have the power of the cunning folk
strengths: They can eaisly hide their abilities
All of their abilities are usefull for every day life
weaknesses: They are not that powerfull
They are very common
They tend to mostly become something like the village docter

name: Soul Music
description: With this ability, simply touch someone and music based on that person's soul will begin to play out of nowhere. The music can be upbeat or depressing, rigid or chaotic, beautiful or terrifying. Each person has a different type of song, and the song that plays will tell you everything you need to know about what type of person they are.
summary: The ability to play the music of a person's soul.
strengths: Listen to people's character and avoid the bad ones.
Have a source of music on hand at all times.
Ply your power to make money.
weaknesses: This could be seen as a massive invasion of privacy.
You may not like what you find out.

name: Myth Power: Lesson Of The Litae
description: The Litai (Litai), in Greek myth, were the nine frail sister goddesses of prayers, repentance and blessings. As such, channeling them allows one to grant up to nine wishes a day, for oneself and/or others. These wishes may be for anything, so long as they do not directly endanger or harm anyone. In addition, one receives divine inspiration and enlightenment when one requires it. One even gains favor by good-aligned gods of the Greek pantheon and immunity to MythPowers based on evil-aligned gods.
summary: The ability to channel the Litae, and their command over the essence of prayers and blessings
strengths: Grant nine benevolent wishes a day, for self and/or others
Receive divine inspiration and enlightenment
Favor with good-aligned gods of the Greek Pantheon; immunity to MythPowers of evil-aligned gods
weaknesses: Only nine wishes or blessings a day. Not nine for you AND nine for others. Nine TOTAL in a day.
Wishes cannot be used to directly endanger or harm anyone
MythPower: Zeus' Zenith provides immunity (NCN)

name: Hersue
description: Hersue is a form of astral projection. The user meditates, and focuses on their targets' face. They will then have a dream-like experience and be in the viscinity of their target, and can see and hear what is happening to them. They can move around, and pass through objects, but no one will be able to see them, making this power perfect for spying. Takes 80 years to master.
summary: The ability to project your spirit to spy on a targeted person.
strengths: Good for spying on enemies or checking up on friends.
Great fun and very practical.
Current Users include but are not limited to - Karru of the Yamin, Christian of the Legure
weaknesses: Youuuuuu stalker.
Takes 80 years to master.
Dead Users include but are not limited to - Nova of the Legure (bwahaha)

name: Shamanic Vessel
description:
When a spirit enters into the body, he/she/it can either temporally take full control of the body, take some part of the body, or sleeps inside the mind, and the host possesses full control of the spirit's abilities/powers. 
You can take a spirit of a dead person who was known to have great strength and possess that same quality (regardless of your stature) you can take a spirit of a physicist to possess great intellect. 
you can take nature spirits, angels, demons, and even be a vessel of gods.
summary: The ability to temporally incorporate any kind of spirit in your body for certain abilities
strengths: You can take spirits with any power/ability and incorporate them.
If you have enough power, you can control ANY spirit inside your body.
You can be a mediating vessel of the Divine.
weaknesses: You have to have other spiritual powers before you can obtain this (such as Spiritual Converse).
If you don't have enough power, you will be overpowered and become fully possessed.

name: Haunting Curse
description: Your enemies will be forever haunted, literally. You can summon dark evil mischievous ghosts to attack your foes. They won't kill but will torture them: physical & psychological, leaving painfully marks, tossing them around, choking, just being a bad poltergeist. They will see & fear their deathly faces. They will continue to haunt till that person is dead. You can only curse one person at a time. A person's faith could save them if strong believer.
summary: The ability to call upon malevolent spirits to haunt & torment someone
strengths: Have badass ghosts do your dirty work
weaknesses: Can only use the power one at a time
A person's strong faith could save them & banish the spirits
They cannot posses the target

name: Minion Animation
description: You can summon characters from animated television shows. But with shows such as Billy and Mandy, and Spongebob you can't summon godly figures (they have Eris and Neptune).
summary: The ability to summon minions from animated shows.
strengths: They become your minion.
weaknesses: No godly figures.
Only the characters.
Only animated shows.

name: Angel Power: Angel's Halo
description: This power allows you to channel the glow that envelops every angel. A warm light that comforts the innocent, but that frightens and agonizes the wicked, and allows you to see clearly through any illusion. Enveloped in this light, your vision is also enhanced; not only can you see in better detail and with better range, but you can see and sense innocents, angels, demons, the spirits of the dead and others with this power; you simply can't communicate with angels, demons or spirits.
summary: The ability to channel the halo of an angel
strengths: Your light is comforting to innocents, and your touch calms them
Your light is frightening to the wicked, and your touch agonizes them
Improved sight; see/sense innocents, angels, demons, spirits of the dead and others with this power
weaknesses: Your sight is improved, but doesn't bestow Clairvoyance, Precognition, Postcognition or the like
If you want to help people who struggle morally, but you scare them
You can't communicate with angels, demons or spirits, just perceive them

name: Summon Atlanteans V2
description: With this power you can summon an army of soldiers from Atlantis. The Atlanteans are under your complete control. They have immensely long life spans, have super strength, can breathe underwater and are adept at magic. You can summon as many as you want and unsummon them when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Atlanteans
strengths: You can summon an army of Atlanteans
You have complete control over them
weaknesses: They can be killed

name: Essence Spell Casting
description: This ability allows the user to sacrifice parts of his own body in order to use a spell. The amount used dictates what kind of spells are optional. The user doesn't even need to give up his own magical energy. Of course, the user will slowly disappear. The user can regenerate, but it will take awhile.
summary: The ability to use spells and enchantments by using one's own physical essence.
strengths: Use spells
Do not need to give up your energy
Parts will come back
weaknesses: Lose parts of your body
Be structurally weaken.

name: Spirit Item Manifestation
description: With this ability you can manifest and demanifest an item which is based off your soul and spirit. The item itself has the ability to focus all of your powers through it, giving them a major boost while increasing your aptitude with them. If you become more powerful your item upgrades itself to a more powerfull form to fit your new found abilities. Unfortunately these items, mostly the weapons, tend to have a mind of their own and may try to kill you if you start to have inner conflict.
summary: The ability to summon a weapon capable of mass destruction out of your spirit
strengths: Summon a weapon, or item capable of mass destruction that can not be stolen
This weapon can guard against energy attacks and effect spirits
You can summon it at will so you don't have to lug it around everywhere
weaknesses: Using the weapon correctly requires training
It may try to kill you
This weapon is only as powerfull as your will, and can be temporarily broken by a stronger one.

name: Night Mare Summon
description: The NightMare is a creature that can bring living creatures nightmares (bad dreams). The nightmares given by a NightMare summoned by this power will be random. The NightMare looks like a ghostly horse with ghostly flames around its ankles and as its mane.
summary: The ability to summon and control a ghostly horse that can bring nightmares to people
strengths: The NightMare can fight for you.
The NightMare can give your enemies nightmares.
weaknesses: The NightMare can really only harm spirits and undead.
Note: Sorry for the (somewhat) puns in this power.
Can't ride the NightMare unless you can touch spirits.

name: Summon Sharke
description: Sharke are 20 ft. long, fly, look like a snake/shark hybrid and have an average IQ. Sharke can eat whole or take a bite from any matter that won't last forever. In the extreme far future, all normal matter won't exist. The Hulk or adamantium could be eaten. Sharke can only be hurt, stopped or contained with psionic, temporal or magical powers. A sharke stays until you unsummon it. You can summon a new one every day, but after a day, any sharke will eat when you're not around.
summary: The ability to summon a temporal energy monster.
strengths: Invulnerability is useless against a sharke.
Have your sharke chew its way into an adamantium vault.
weaknesses: If one sharke might be too much trouble to keep around more than a day.
Anyone with time control powers.
Any foes who could live forever.

name: Soul Bullet
description: The bullet increases its power, speed, and will go through any obstacle as of it was a ghost until it reaches the target.
summary: The ability to infuse a bullet with a piece of your soul.
strengths: More power.
Hiding behind a wall wont save the target.
weaknesses: Soul skills take time to recharge. (about 30 min)
If you are shooting through the wall you can still miss.

name: M.S.C.P.
description: M.S.C.P. stands for Multi Spiritual Combination Possession. You can summon two, three or more spirits that are good and/or evil at your command to possess you to gain new powers and personalities, also to become one being.
summary: The ability to have 2, 3, or more spirits to possess you to gain new powers and personalities.
strengths: Can use the combined powers of the multiple spirits of the heroes and villains to merge with you.
weaknesses: Those spirits you possessed will try to take control of you.

name: Final Fantasy Mimicry
description:
Ever played final fantasy? I have. 
This ability allows you to mimic any character or a job class from any final fantasy. This also includes summons like Ifrit, Shiva, Bahamut, etc. And only incorporates usable characters. This also includes one-time characters, like Sephiroth. 
(I'd mimic him first. )
summary: The ability to mimic any character or job class from the final fantasies.
strengths: Mimic any final fantasy character or job class.
Are able to mimic the summons, espers, gf's, aeons or eidolons.
Mimic Gogo from ff6 or the mimic job class, gives you the ultimate mimicry ability.
weaknesses: You can only mimic the characters' from the final fantasies you own.

You won't need to buy a guard dog
weaknesses: You have to own the card (they have to be bought, be given to you or won fairly)
They might not let you enter tournaments anymore
It would turn a fun game into a life or death scenario

name: Crusader's Faith
description: Crusader's Faith provides not only immunity to, but also the general nullification of any faith based, god or god-like powers that are used on, around, or in the general vicinity of you, unless they are the faith based or god powers of your god.

strengths: Immunity to the faith based and god powers of other faiths.
Nullification of fath based and god powers of other faiths.
weaknesses: Religious bloodlust.
May become extremely judgemental and hypocritical.

name: Black Cat's Dance
description: This insidious power allows the user to alter probability, absorbing the good luck of another person and passing on any bad luck he or she possesses to that person as well. This means that the user will not only drain them of their good luck and leave them with their own bad luck, he or she will leave them with his or her bad luck as well. The possessor of this ability can use it consciously 12 times a week, but once a week it will be triggered unconsciously as well.
summary: The ability to cause another person bad luck by crossing his or her path.
strengths: Great way to boost your luck before hitting the casinos!
Good way of getting revenge, especially if your foe is lucky.
Good for a career in sports, medicine, or politics.
weaknesses: You quickly get a reputation as a jinx or a "Jonah. "
The ability may affect friends and loved ones when it goes off unconsciously.
On Friday the 13th, the effect of this ability is reversed!

name: Magic Negation
description: With this ability, you become the very antithesis of magic; any magical effect is automatically negated in your presence; magic spells will fail, curses falter and fade away; magical traps vanish into thin air, and magical illusions are suppressed, to reveal the truth behind them. What's best, not only do you negate the magical enhancements of others, but magic that touches your body cannot affect you AT ALL.

strengths: Negate magical spells and effects that have already been produced
Prevent magic from being used in the first place
Magic touches your body, it's negated (naturally immune to magic)
weaknesses: Mages HATE you...
No magical enhancements
No magical assistance AT ALL...

name: Percussive Awakening
description: With this ability the user can awaken anyone, from any degree, or type of sleep by hitting them. This includes naps, to comas, to even eternal sleep, this counters superpowers and magic, that induce sleep. This power also creates thirty minutes of immunity to sleep related powers.
summary: The ability to wake anyone by hitting them.
strengths: Wake up a comatose friend.
Thirty minute immunity to sleep powers.
weaknesses: Friends who make you hit yourself in your sleep.
You could accidently hit yourself.

name: Sign Language Magic
description: Magic users can cast magical spells using sign language to sign out the spell they desire to cast

strengths: Can cast extremely powerful spells to fight other magic users or non-magic users
Someone with these power can also talk to deaf people when they are not using their magic
weaknesses: They first have to learn sign language to a high degree of proficiency
If the magical user's hand or hands were to be broken, they would not be able to sign spells
Might take a long time to spell cast if the spell is too long

name: Ghost Writing
description: To harness this power, you have to choose a keyword; for example, "super". Every time you write the word "super" you turn into a ghost temporarily. In this state, you have the standard ghost powers (flying, intangibility, invisibility, etc. ) After thirty minutes, the power will wear off, and you will not be able to use this power for the rest of the day (unless you develop it). It's good to carry a pencil around if you have this power.
summary: The ability to turn into a ghost temporarily after writing
strengths: You can transform into a ghostly state.
You can fly, phase, be invisible, etc.
weaknesses: You might have to carry a pencil around in case you need the power
This can only be used once per day, until developed
Don't forget your keyword!

name: Myth Power: Hecate's Hex
description: Hecate (Hekate), in Greek myth, was the goddess of magic, witchcraft, spirits, necromancy and crossroads. As such, channeling her endows powerful magic; one can brew magic potions and charms (such as love charms, transmutation potions and magic remedies), hex foes, etc. In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with ghosts/spirits and witches, as well as withstand magic/necromantic effects. Furthermore, one gains physical and magic power during the new moon, and at crossroads.
summary: The ability to channel Hekate's command over the essence of magic, witchcraft, spirits, necromancy and crossroads
strengths: Powerful magic at your disposal (hex/jinx/curse foes, assist allies, shapeshift, cast illusion, etc)
Psychically perceive and communicate with ghosts/spirits/undead and witches/necromancers/mages
Become more physically and magically powerful during the New Moon and/or at crossroads
weaknesses: Cannot compel ghosts/spirits/undead, witches/mages or black dogs until the higher levels (NCN)
Until the higher levels, even immune to direct magical BENEFITS (NCN)
Disrespecting spirits (desecrate graves, etc), directly harming spirits or mages disrupts power use

name: Snack Time!
description: With this ability, you can have a snack anytime. You can summon as many snacks as you want. Snacks disappear after 48 hours. You can't summon meals or drinks with this power. No exceptions.

strengths: Have a snack whenever you want!
No limit to the amount of snacks!
Have a midnight snack!
weaknesses: You can't summon meals.
You can't summon drinks.
No exceptions.

name: Reverse Possession
description: Instead of allowing a ghost to possess YOU, YOU can possess a ghost. This ability allows you to climb into a ghost's form and gain control of its mind. You then have all the powers of a ghost and partial invulnerability. Note: This power is only to be used on friendly spirits. Evil spirits can override your control and destroy you. Friendly spirits tend to forgive and forget.

strengths: You can possess a ghost.
You gain all of the ghost's powers.
In this state, you are partially invulnerable.
weaknesses: If you do this on evil spirits... They'll destroy you.

name: Like Spell
description: This ability allows you to cast a spell to make anyone like anyone else. You can also use the spell to make anyone like you. The duration of the spell depends on how much someone liked someone else before the spell. If someone hated someone else (or you), the spell only lasts 3 hours. If someone already liked someone, the spell lasts 3 months. The spell duration varies. Someone might like someone else (or you) even if the spell wears off. The effects wear off if you tell them about the spell.
summary: The ability to cast a spell to make anyone like anyone else.
strengths: Make people like (not love) others.
Make friends more easily.
Even works on people who dislike others or you.
weaknesses: Spell must remain a secret. Telling them about the spell breaks it.
Spell doesn't last as long on those who dislike the other person.
Someone might like you even if the spell wears off. Bad if you don't like them.

name: God Phone V4
description: With this power you can summon any of the Gods or Goddesses from Norse Mythology. strengths: You can summon any of the Norse Gods and Goddesses
You can summon as many of them as you want
They might help you
weaknesses: They might kill you

name: Eight Virtues
description: The ability to possess all Eight Virtues. Charity, Temperance, Chastity, Patience, Kindness, Diligence, Humility and Justice. This power lets you purify a soul and they will see the light to know what evil things they done. E.g Chastity - The person will embrace moral wholesomeness. Diligence - The Person will have a careful nature and total work ethics.

strengths: Can cast all Eight Virtues onto anybody at once.
weaknesses: Nothing bad about this power at all.

name: Lich Transformation
description: If you have this power you can turn yourself into a lich when you die. A lich (pronounced lik) is someone with power who didn't want to die. Because of this they do some ritual to prevent themselves from dying. They also retain intelligence and have increased magical power. This power takes out the ritual part that most lichs did, but your body has to die for this power to work and it has to be in one piece. You do retain your physical looks but your body will be slowly decaying.

weaknesses: You're undead and you will generally be thought of as evil regardless of whether or not you are.

Your body has to be in one piece.

Destroy an opponent's darkness spell

description:
This power allows you to temporarily usurp all powers of a single angelic entity, leaving it completely powerless in the process. Your appearance will change to reflect the angel whose powers you have usurped (i. E. : white wings, clothing or other symbolic changes). 
You gain their powers at exactly the same level of the original angel. Line of sight is required, otherwise you will gain the powers of a random angel who could be anywhere at the moment. You have no knowledge when Usurpation ends.

If you try to extend the 10 sec limit, you cannot use this power for 1 week. The bullets can pierce through magical things, but dissipate a sec after firing. Bullet per second rate can be increased with hard training.

Even if they SEE you write it, you can claim it was written by Britney Spears, or President Obama or any other existing person, and people will believe you. Archives and Libraries can be summoned by the Archivist as well allowing access to knowledge, protection, and resources for the Archivists powers.
