name: Angelic Hierarchy: Rulers
description: The Rulers, often known as the Principalities, tend to collaborate their duties with those of the Powers. The Rulers appear as pointed-eared humanoids with ruby-studded crowns, along with a pair of sable-coloured scalloped wings. The Rulers also carry winged scepters from which they draw most of their power. Their primary duties are said to carry out the orders given to them by the Dominions. Rulers also have been said to inspire art and science.
summary: The ability to become an angel of both authority and power.
strengths: Inspire brilliant ideas to many living things.
Draw immense power and strength from your scepter.
Annihilate multiple targets with a "heavenly beam" from your scepter.
weaknesses: Rulers are still vulnerable to stronger angelic/demonic forces.

name: Summoning: Janus's Key
description: Janus is the Roman god of doors and such. You can now summon his Key, which has the ability to unlock any door or chest that isn't enchanted. The key is easily recognizable by the fact it depicts two differing faces, the symbol most common with Janus.
summary: The ability to use the Key of Janus.
strengths: Unlocks chests and doors.
weaknesses: Only works on non-magical items.

name: Magic Diffusing Mist
description: Any magic that enters the mist will have its effect be half as powerful for each second while in the mist and if it exits the mist for each second while it was in the mist it will take two seconds longer to regain full power. Anyone who breathes in the mist cannot use magic until they get the mist out of their body. You can generate the mist at any rate from 0 milliliters per second to 5 liters per second. You can only gain this power by being hit by 1000 harmful magic spells within 24 hours.
summary: The ability to generate a mist in which magic is weakened
strengths: 1 second in mist: 1/2 as powerful. 2 seconds: 1/4 as powerful. 3 seconds: 1/8 as powerful.
weaknesses: You cannot hit yourself with your own spells to gain this power.
You cannot use any magic while using this power.

name: Roulette Wheel
description: With this power you can summon a roulette wheel that will levitate near you. You can then make a bet that something will happen and numbers on the roulette wheel will light up. The more extreme the bet, the less numbers will light up. You will then spin a ball that comes with the roulette wheel on the wheel and if the ball lands in one of the slots for the lit up numbers then what you bet will come true. If your bet wrong then something bad will happen to you similar to what you bet.
summary: The ability to summon a roulette wheel that you can use to make magical bets.
strengths: Can summon it for use at any time.
Can bet that near anything would happen, and cause it to become true.
If you are lucky or have luck powers.
weaknesses: If you have bad luck.
The more exteme a bet is the less likely that you will get what you want.
If you get the bet wrong then you will face consequences.

name: Unknown Immortality
description: No one will know you. No one will know your name, your face, or your opinions. Not even your family and friends. People will forget that you ever existed. In exchange for this, you will be made immortal (barring accidents). With this power, you can spend eternity living like a ghost, staying and taking whatever you want, but no person will ever speak to you or acknowledge your presence.
summary: The ability to live forever in obscurity
strengths: Live forever.
Stay wherever and take whatever you like.
No one will ever acknowledge you.
weaknesses: No one will EVER acknowledge you.

name: Full Metal Alchemists: Pride
description: Prides abilities are very useful.  First, you become an umbrakinetic.  Anything that encounters your shadow you will be able to devour/slice through it.  You can exist in two forms, your original human form and a shadowy form, you can exist in the shadowy form, but when the shadow is gone you will need to go to the other form.  You gain all knowledge and abilities of those who you devour.
summary: The ability to have the abilities of the sin, pride.
strengths: You can control darkness.
You exist in two forms.
You gain all knowledge and abilities of who you devour.
weaknesses: There needs to be a light source for a shadow to exist.
You attempt things that are out of the ordinary, with pride in yourself.

name: Summon Mini Sharke
description: Mini-sharke are 7 inches long, can fly, and look like a eel/baby shark mix. Mini-sharke can take tiny little bites out of any matter that won't last forever, Wolverine's claws or Superman for example. Mini-sharke make up for their tiny size by being of genius IQ and possessing invisibility. They only thing that will hurt, stop or contain them are psionic, temporal or magical powers. A mini-sharke stays until you unsummon it. You can summon a new one every day. Mini-sharke can go unsupervised.
summary: The ability to summon a tiny temporal energy monster
strengths: A extremely smart,small,flying and invisible spy.
You have no reason to unsummon them. They're house pets.
They can turn invisible and attack as a swarm.
weaknesses: You may become a mini-sharke collector.
You give them cute names.
If your not smart enough--will you understand what they're saying?

name: Myth Power: Corymbos' Course
description: Corymbos (Corymbus, Korymbos), in Greek myth, was the god of the ivy plant, which crowned ancient Greek mystery initiates' heads. As such, channeling him allows one to psychically summon a crown of ivy to one's head, at will, to withstand compulsions, magic and reality bending, at will. In addition, one can psychically summon crowns to subjects' heads, by touch, to dominate them, at will. One can even psychically launch ivy berries from crowns, and detonate them with power like bombs, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Corymbos' command over the essence of the ivy plant, used to crown mystery initiates
strengths: Psychically summon an ivy crown to one's head, to withstand compulsions, magic and reality bending
Psychically crown subjects with ivy to dominate their minds, by touch, at will
Psychically launch ivy-crown berries, explode them like bombs; ivy crowns near impossible to remove
weaknesses: If crowns are unremoved, user's sleep/unconsciousness/death put the crowned in a coma (NCN)
Pro #2 cannot bypass mental defenses until developed (NCN)
Eleusinian cult-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Soul Eating Breath
description: You breathe a black cloud acting as a spiritual acid, partially dissolving the soul of any living thing it touches and channeling the energy back to you, boosting you physically and spiritually. Eventually, it will completely devour the soul of the target. The cloud is steerable to a certain extent, and its speed and area depend largely on the power and skill of the user. The most proficient users of this ability have been known to wipe planets clean of all life, even bacteria, in an hour.
summary: The ability to erode life energy and strengthen yourself with your breath
strengths: Will kill anything with enough use
Bestows massive amounts of energy
Nearly unblockable (the cloud is made of an antilife solution)
weaknesses: Ineffective against nonliving targets
The cloud is a bit difficult to control, and will affect anyone it touches
Excessive movement will break the link and negate the ability

name: Summoning: Symbiotic Parasite
description: Symbiotic Parasite, a cruel uncaring demonic creature that latches onto people. Once summoned, it will latch onto the user, using the user's body to survive. The person whom it attaches to gains incredible powers for the cost of hosting the parasitic demon.
summary: The ability to summon a Symbiotic Parasite.
strengths: Incredible power.
weaknesses: Saps your energy at times.

name: Demon Doppleganger
description: Everyone has a demon doppleganger, most are sealed away. Some are good, some are bad.
summary: The ability to trade places with your Demon Doppleganger
strengths: Gain demonic powers
More resilient
weaknesses: Demons are both good and bad
Might be stuck in demon form depending on the demon

name: X Men Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character who has ever been a member of the X-Men even if they're no longer a member anymore
summary: The ability to summon any member of the X-Men
strengths: You can summon powerful heroes to help you
weaknesses: They don't have to help you

name: Wing Arms
description: When you think of winged people, you naturally assume the wings are attached to their backs, right? People with this genetic alteration have wings attached to their arms instead. They do retract, with one extra section folding down into a groove in the forearm.
summary: The ability to have wings that are attached to your arms
strengths: You can fly.
The wings are retractable.
weaknesses: X-rays (people freaking out about the extra bone in your arm).
You can't carry stuff with your arms while you're flying.

name: Innocence Weapons
description: With this ability you can summon any of the innocence weapons from the show D. Grayman. Upon summoning you will have all the knowledge and skill required to use the weapon. The weapons can only be used for good purposes and will not work for those who are evil. Demons defeated by the weapons will be purified. Can only use one of the Innocence Weapons at a time.
summary: The ability to summon and use exorcist weapons from D. Grayman
strengths: Many different exorcist weapons.
Very strong for those who are good and going against evil.
You automatically know how to use the Innocence weapon upon summoning.
weaknesses: Can only use one at a time
Does not work for those that are evil
Can only use ones from the show.

name: Death By Future
description: Also known as Undead Doppelganger, the person with this ability can summon the dead souls of anybody in order to kill the person that they are the dead form of. So, for example, if I summoned the dead soul of Superman, then a ghastly figure with all the powers of Superman will appear to kill him. Also, the doppelganger is already dead, so it can't be killed normally. It requires knowledge of magic in order to kill it/restrain it. The dead form also knows everything the person knows constantly.
summary: The ability to summon dead souls from the future to kill their present forms
strengths: The dead souls know all of the present form's strengths and weaknesses
Make people technically kill themselves
The dead souls will definitely not switch sides and their only purpose is to kill themselves
weaknesses: It's cruel to make people kill themselves and this power takes time to cast
If the person is immortal (still they have an immortal enemy though)
Can be countered using magic

name: Holy Power: Bloody Spirit
description: Using the Reaper Scythe, you can summon a Bloody Spirit, a powerful Spirit made of many condemned souls and forged with rage in the deeps of hell. This Spirit will follow all your orders because he has no main mind, and the more souls he is made of, the more powerful he is. The Bloody Spirit has the power of Telekinesis, Intangibility, Super Strength, Flight and a little Darkness Control. Using this power might cause damage to your own soul. Bloody Spirit can be exorcised.
summary: The ability to summon a powerful spirit, made of many condemned souls and forged with rage with the Reaper Scythe.
strengths: Really powerful, one of the strongest of the HolyPowers.
The Bloody Spirit is nearly invincible.
Bloody Spirit follow all your orders.
weaknesses: Wastes so much energy that your soul is damaged.
Although its really hard to do this, the Bloody Spirit can be defeated.

name: Orbis Sensualium Pictus
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a book appears that can give you detailed information about anything supernatural (magic, demons, angels, etc. ).
summary: The ability to look up any information about the supernatural.
strengths: Comes with a broom that can be used for magic and flying.
weaknesses: Information is constantly being updated so something might get deleted.
Searching for the exact information you want may take a while.

name: Keep Moving Or Else
description: This power allows you to put a curse on anybody which causes them to die if they stop moving. You cannot remove the curse from the person and you can curse as many people as you want.
summary: The ability to cause people to die if they stop moving
strengths: You can cause people to die if they stop moving
You can curse as many people as you want
weaknesses: You cannot remove the curse

name: Soul Eating
description: The power gained is equal to the power of the soul eaten. This power allows you to physically grab souls.
summary: The ability to gain power by eating souls
strengths: It doesn't matter whether the souls are good or evil.
weaknesses: If you can only find weak souls.

name: Chibi Summon
description: With this power you can summon chibi versions of any person that you've ever met. The chibi will act pretty much like the person they are based on only they will act cuter and more exaggerated. You can unsummon the chibis whenever you feel like.
summary: The ability to summon chibified versions of anyone you've ever met
strengths: You can summon chibi versions of any person you've ever met
You can unsummon the chibis whenever you like
weaknesses: They are not under your control

name: Rose Of Sithis
description: The Rose of Sithis, the god of destruction, comes to the aid of those with this power. All of their problems would disappear because it destroys the target instantly! There is only one arrow. BUT! You can call the arrow to your hand by shouting "Sithis! Give me the arrow that has claimed so many lives and souls!" and lo and behold, it's in your hand!
summary: The ability to fire an arrow that will summon the Grim Reaper to the target.
strengths: Kill anyone
No one will sass you again!
Dont have to pay off debts :)
weaknesses: People WILL fear you
Might get corrupted

name: Field Of Fail
description: This power creates a area from a 5ft cube to a 1000ft cube. Anything entering the cube other than the caster is under the effect of epic fail while in the cube. Is magical and luck based.
summary: The ability to creates a field where epic fails occur
strengths: Is funny. Example cast on stoplight :)
weaknesses: Can be negated by more powerfull effect that is opposite but not from within as attemting to do this
they would be under the effect of epic fail and would fail in their attempt

name: Dark Powers: Schizofrenia
description: With this power you can summon Schizofrenia, a pack of terrible monster wolves. These creatures look like really creepy wolves with stitched mouths. But when they start to show their true form, it's revealed that they are truly demons. When fully transformed, the creatures are able to talk like a really mean person, making their target unable to think, without the wolves hearing them. When the enemy is unable to resist, they kill him slowly. This power naturally turns you evil.
summary: The ability to summon wolf like creatures that drive your enemies crazy before killing them.
strengths: You can kill someone in a terrible way.
You can fully control The Pack, and only you and your target can see the Schizofrenia.
The wolves can read the target's mind, and they know how to hurt him/her.
weaknesses: The wolves are not hallucinations, your target can kill them if he is realizes this.
You can summon another wolf if one dies, but killing you would make them all disappear.
This power slowly turns you evil, and you become addicted to using it.

name: Batman Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any vehicle that Batman has used. You can summon any kind of Batmobile, Batwing, Bat Boat, Batcycle, Bat Pod, etc. This power also gives you the knowledge of how to operate the vehicles.
summary: The ability to summon any vehicle from Batman
strengths: You can summon any Batman vehicle.
You know how to operate the vehicle.
You can unsummon them when you're done.
weaknesses: The vehicles can be destroyed.

name: Dragon Wand
description: The Dragon Wand is an unnatural and mystical artifact. It is a two and a half-foot long steel wand with an Emerald Dragon's head on top with dark red eyes. it can grant you great powers, primarily used for casting spells--enhancing, multiplying, gathering, focusing and redirecting mystical energies, etc. It only works when you say them in Chinese and/or Japanese.
summary: The ability to gain supernatural powers & abilities from a Chinese sceptre
strengths: The Dragon Wand has been shown to only to destroy dark magical creatures or objects.
Vast potential
weaknesses: You may only cast spells when you say them in Chinese and/or Japanese.

name: Angelic Resonance
description: The resonance wil only work if the person has love in their heart. The more love they have the more powerful of an angel they will become. Appearances change dependant on the person becoming an angel.
summary: The ability to resonate with a person in such a way that they turn into an angel
strengths: Better against villains than heroes, usually.
weaknesses: Never ever use this against a hero.
Can't use this on yourself.
Can make a villain loved and revered by the superstitious.

name: Flute Of The Spirits
description: When you play this native American flute, you summon a bunch of vengeful Apache warriors, who are good at guerilla warfare. They are mortal and their strength comes from their anger. It's an honor to have this flute.
summary: The ability to use a native American flute to summon Apache warriors
strengths: They are good at guerilla warfare
The flute is made from elk horn
It's a honor to have this flute
weaknesses: The Apache warriors hate the government and its people
They do not trust the American army
They speak Apache (no con negation)

name: Swordsman Power V1
description: With this power you can summon two swordsmen, who know everything there is to know about swordfighting. These swordsmen are very proficient/skilled in it, but not invincible.  They have normal swords and when one is destroyed, you can always summon another one.
summary: The ability to summon two master swordsmen
strengths: You have two expert swordsmen for body guards
You can summon another one when one dies
They might teach you how to be an expert swordsman yourself
weaknesses: You can only summon two at a time
They can die
They only have normal swords

name: Construction Vehicles V2
description: With this power you can summon any kind of construction vehicles. You can summon cranes, dump trucks, bulldozers etc. You also know how to operate them and you can unsummon them when you're done with them.
summary: The ability to summon any construction vehicles
strengths: You can summon construction vehicles
You know how to operate the vehicle
You can unsummon them when you're done
weaknesses: Just because you know how to operate them doesn't mean you'll have any place to operate them in

name: Pen Spawning
description: If you find yourself without a pen, you can automatically spawn one somewhere on you/in a pocket. Useful if you need to write something down. Doesn't provide paper.
summary: The ability to always have a pen
strengths: You always have a pen.
weaknesses: Doesn't provide paper.

name: Reincarnation 5: Soul Link
description: This power has three good purposes. First, all those linked can mentally communicate. Second, they can each find each other unless they do not wish to be found. Thirdly, if one member of the group is still attached to the world, the others will be too. The dead are in the form of ghosts, unable to be seen by many outside the group. There is no limit to the number of people possible to put in this group. If the owner dies, they are all still connected, but they cannot get new members.
summary: The ability to link the souls of a team.
strengths: As long as one member's soul is still attached to the world, they all are.
Can all mentally communicate.
Can all find each other.
weaknesses: Need one member to remain attached to the world, if only through objects.
Useless without a few members.
If the owner of this power dies, they group can't get more members.

name: Claymore: Terracotta Army
description: This gives you a set of claymores; with these claymores you can summon and command the terracotta army with your mind. The army consists of eight thousand soldiers, a hundred and thirty chariots, five hundred and twenty horses, and one hundred and fifty cavalry horses. In other words, you have a massive army, but they are not immortal. The claymore looks like William Wallis' claymore.
summary: The ability to posses a claymore that can summon and command the terracotta army
strengths: You have a massive army.
The claymore can be used as a weapon
They are under you full command
weaknesses: you can only have one claymore ( no con negation )
They are not immortal
They can only kill spirits.

name: 50 Orbs Of Life'
description: You can summon 50 orbs that contain the power of 50 lives (that's 1 life per orb). The power in each orb is used to boost your other powers beyond their normal maximums. TABOO: You cannot use so much power from an orb that you kill the one from whom the orb draws its power otherwise you will lose all your powers and be banned from ever having powers again. NOTE: If you drain the majority of the power from one of the orbs (50%-99%), it takes one week for the orb to reach full power again.
summary: The ability to summon 50 orbs that contain the power of 50 lives in them
strengths: Have the power of 50 lives at your fingertips. May be con if you forget about the taboo.
Can use the power to temporarily boost your powers.
Orbs have full power after 8 hours unless 50%-99% of power was used.
weaknesses: Useless unless you have other powers.
If the person an orb drains from dies by some other cause, you do not get a new orb.
Con Negation and other alteration powers have no effect on this power.

name: Card Immunity
description: Any power that has to do with cards won't affect you. This includes both negative and benificial effects.
summary: The ability to be immune to cards and card-based powers
strengths: No more getting paper cuts from cards!
weaknesses: For some versions this power applies only to cards OR card-based powers.

name: De Dracula
description: With this power, you can removes curses, spells, diseases and other (unnatural) effects that causes someone's body and/or personality to change. E.g. you can cure somebody that has been turned into a vampire, or werewolf, or zombie.
summary: The ability to undo body and personality changing effects.
strengths: Cure werewolves, vampires, zombies and other ghouls.
You are immune to such unnatural change
Become more famous than Van Helsing
weaknesses: Only works if someone was different before (no effect on summoned creatures)

name: God Phone
description: With this power you can summon any of the Gods or Goddesses from Greek Mythology including, the minor gods.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Greek Gods and Goddesses
strengths: If you have a good reason they may help you
Just having one of the gods near you is enough to scar an enemy
weaknesses: They might not want to help you
They might destroy you if you summoned them when they were doing something important

name: Moon Blade 3rd: Virgin White
description: Sword has a grey hilt, and a completely white blade which is as tall and wide as an average human.
summary: The ability to create a blade which is resistant against all magic attacks.
strengths: Blade can absorb, and negate any magic attack.
Has incredible physical strength and durability.
weaknesses: Very big and requires a strong person to wield it.
Can not stop attacks that attack you from below unless you are standing on the blade.

name: Magic Makeover
description: This team of professional magic makeover artists do makeovers for people, homes, and more! They're the best at what they do! They're magic, meaning they can do things that other makeover artists cannot, whether they're professional or not! The makeovers suit the person that they're meant for! You can summon this professional magic makeover team at any time and they will get the job done instantly for free! Please enjoy!
summary: The ability to summon a team of professional magic makeover artists
strengths: Makeovers for people, homes, and more!
They're magic, meaning they can do things that other makeover artists cannot!
They will get the job done instantly for free!

name: Time To Duel!
description: You'll be able to summon Yugioh Monsters, like the cards from the game!   You'll have infinite lifepoints when using your powers against someone without the same powers, so you'll be able to take a bullet!   when dueling, you'll have real cards happen before you while your opponent will have the basic cards...
summary: The ability to summon monsters, use traps and spells from the Yugioh card game and they are real!
strengths: You'll be like Akiza from Yugioh 5Ds
You'll be the envy of other duelists
You can summon Obelisk the Tormentor!!!!!!!!
weaknesses: You won't have a duel challenge unless you meet someone else with the same power
You might accidentally kill someone
You need to draw the cards you want to use

name: Additional Pylons
description: Summon a floating pylon to any location that powers or fuels anything within its radius. The size of the pylon can be changed, but the radius of the power changes equal to the size. Larger pylons take more focus and control to summon. Pylon colors can be changed, but this has no effect on what it does. Pylons can be destroyed or unsummoned. Pylons cannot be summoned if another object is in the way.
summary: The ability to summon an unlimited number of Protoss Pylons.

Color and size can be controlled.
Unlimited amount.
weaknesses: Can be destroyed or unsummoned.
Radius of power is limited by the size of the pylon.
Will always need additional pylons to power new areas.

name: Myth Power: Memento Moros
description: Moros (Morus, Olethros, Olethrus), in Greek myth, was the god of doom, destructive forces and depression. As such, channeling him allows one to to perceive details of a subject's past/present/future death, at will (this may be shared by touch). In addition, one can psychically perceive and communicate with doomsayers, pessimists, and those fated to die soon. Furthermore, one can cause matter to wither and decay, by touch, at will. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
summary: The ability to channel Moros' command over the essence of depression and impending doom and destruction
strengths: Psychically perceive details of a subject's past/present/future death by touch (shared by touch)
Psychically perceive and communicate with doomsayers, pessimists and those fated to die soon

Unpredictability and Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: Opposite Sex Mirrors
description: These special mirrors let you see how you would look in your opposite sex! Even your clothes & other accessories are gender-bended in the reflection! However, your real gender hasn't actually changed.

strengths: See how you would look if you were born in your opposite sex.
Play the fun game of how clothes, shoes, & more will look in the reflections!
weaknesses: If you break these special mirrors, it's 14 years bad luck! (7 for each gender)
Androgynous things will still look exactly the same in the reflections... Boring!

name: Bob Omb Summon
description: With this power you can summon an unlimited amount of Bob-ombs from the Mario series. They are under your complete control and you can also control when they explode or prevent them from exploding. You can unsummon them when you're done.
summary: The ability to summon an army of Bob-ombs
strengths: You can summon an army of Bob-ombs

You can control when they explode
weaknesses: You can be hurt by the explosions

name: Ghost Of The Past
description: The past ghost is a white-robed, androgynous figure of indeterminate age, with a head of blazing light reminiscent of a candle flame. This spirit grabs your hand, takes you far back into the past to show you what you were like, have been missing in your live and what you should never should do wrong.
summary: The ability to summon a sprit to let a person to view his/her past.
strengths: You and your past ghost see others and they cannot see you.
It could redeem a person
weaknesses: You cannot even talk to others while you are with the past spirit.

name: The Heroes Curse
description: From the beginning to the end of your life, you will always be a hero. Whenever someone or something around you is in trouble, you will have to help them. At the end of your life, you must pass on The Heroes Curse to another. Life must always have a hero.

weaknesses: Always being a hero

name: Celtic Invocation: Samhain
description: By using this ability, the invoker can utilise all the powers Samhain gives. As the last harvest, Samhain allows the invoker to cause all ripe and ready plant life nearby to be harvested instantly, such as having the apples instantly picked, and the wheat scythed and sheaved. It also allows the invoker to summon and communicate with the spirits of the dead, but not control or command them. Finally, it allows the invoker to take away someone's life by wailing the targets name seven times
summary: The ability to channel the power of Samhain, the first day of winter and the beginning of the darker times.
strengths: Instant harvest. No need for any hard work.

You'll be highly popular this day.
weaknesses: Only available once a year.
