name: Hellbound
description: If someone pisses you off, all you have to do is say: "Go to Hell! " and in 6 days, they will be pulled into the fiery pits. For those 6 days, they will be tortured, afraid, seeing shadow demons, become ill, feel hot temperatures, get scratch and bite marks, and pests and vermin swarming around them. Almost nothing can save them, be it faith and exorcism. They'll soon become suicidal and just that will open hell gates and spike tentacles, hot barbed chains and demon claws will drag them to hell.
summary: The ability to send someone to hell
strengths: Torture and get rid of the people you don't like by giving them the ultimate curse
For 6 days, they will have the worst days ever
weaknesses: Spell might be broken depending on how strong their faith is
Watch what you say to people cause you can't undo the spell

name: Demonic Weaponry: Hysteria
description: Hysteria is a weapon that takes the form of a small blacksmith's hammer. Its power isn't for combat against multiple people. When you tap someone with it, or hit them with it, it will produce a vibration that will ring through the target's ears. The sound will resemble that of a banshee's shriek. It is mostly effective when used against the head.
summary: The ability to summon Hysteria.
strengths: Disorientate people in combat, leaving them open for other attacks.
weaknesses: Isn't useful for fighting multiple people.

name: Muggle Protector
description: As long as they are in your vicinity, any being without superpowers will become immune to direct superpower effects. Having this immunity doesn't count as having a power, otherwise it would paradoxical. Someone with a magical artifact, even if they originally don't have any powers, doesn't count as being powerless. You are not protected by this ability because you have at least one power.
summary: The ability to protect powerless and depowered beings in your vicinity against superpower effects.
strengths: You can protect your loved ones when you're with them, so you don't have to worry about their safety
With experience, you can increase the maximum range of this power.
Protect the people who could get caught in the middle of a fight between you and another superhuman.
weaknesses: Passive ability. Though, with experience, you can control the range of the protection.
Your powers may not work against powerless or depowered foes if they are in the protection zone.
You are not protected and it only protects from direct superpower effects.

name: Weapon: Treeslayer
description: Miraculously light for an axe of its size, the Treeslayer can cut cleanly through and/or destroy any tree or item with origins rooted in trees including, but not limited to trees, paper, metal forged with the heat coal with trees, magical spells which whose caster learned off paper scrolls and some types of wicker furniture. The wielder may also strike with the force of a tree against users of these products, which tree depending on the intent behind the blow.
summary: The ability to wield the Treeslayer, the bane of all tree-based products.
strengths: Can strike like a Dwarf Willow or with the force of a Giant Sequoia, without changing its weight.
Conditions to activate its powers can be numerous and met varyingly or creatively.
Functions also as a sharp, rather heavy axe against non-tree-associated things or people.
weaknesses: Wielder must know or correctly guess the target's link with trees to use the powers.
That link must have fewer than 4 transitions from an organic form of the tree (including coal/oil)
Fire renders the Treeslayer unusable, though it can fully regenerate in up to 6 months.

name: Speech To Sign
description: With this power you can change powers that require some sort of spell or phrase to activate into powers that you can use sign language to activate. All you have to do is say the name of the power in sign language. The power can no longer be activated by speaking once you use this power on it.
summary: The ability to change powers you need word to activate to powers you need sign language to activate
strengths: If you're unable to speak this power opens up several new power opportunities for you
weaknesses: Once you use this power on another power the power can no longer be activated through speech

name: Reaper Claw: Final Stage
description: Unlike reaper claw 1&2 which have different abilities reaper claw: final stage only has one and that ability is total oblivion. When you activated reaper claw: final stage azrael the angel of death will appear and merge with you arm. I'll explain this part in the pros&cons and describe the merging in a comment. The attack is simple when it connects the opponent his body/soul/ and aura are completely destroyed and no power from neither heaven nor hell or earth can bring him/her back ever.
summary: The ability to completely obliterate your opponent
strengths: There are no good qualities to this power
It is a somewhat dark technique
And should only be used as a last resort
weaknesses: Unlike stage 1&2 there is no risk of injury however if overused your arm will die
To use this stage you must first master 1st and 2nd stage which will impress and befriend azreal
I listed this as a con because i don't know if befriending him is a good thing

name: Autobot Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Autobot or Maximal. Applicable to any show or continuity.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Autobots
strengths: You can summon any Autobot/Maximal from G1 Optimus Prime to Movie Jetfire and everybody else
weaknesses: They don't have to help you fight
You might loose them when they're in their alt modes (unless of course they're a dinobot)

name: Demonic Presence
description: Anyone you encounters will be intimidated/scared by you and believe that you are a demon. Also they will try to get rid of you with all conventional anti-demon methods. Ex: crosses, churches, etc.
summary: The ability to have a presence that is demonic
strengths: You may not have any enemies, just superstitious people who try to ward you away.
weaknesses: Someone has to know you really well in order for this power to not affect them.
People may think you're evil, even if you aren't.

name: Myth Power: Macaria's Whim
description: Macaria (Makaria), in Greek myth, was the goddess of a blessed death and afterlife. As such, channeling her allows one to perceive whether a subject's spirit goes to Heaven or Hell after they die. In addition, one may erase a foe's memories of any good deeds he has done in the past, at will, so he thinks he is a villain; from that point on, he will lead a life worthy of Hell. The same may even be done with allies (erasing memories of past sins, so from then on, they lead lives worthy of Heaven).
summary: The ability to channel Macaria's command over the essence of a blessed death and afterlife
strengths: Perceive whether a subject goes to Heaven or Hell after they die
Help allies lead lives worthy of blessedness; cause foes to lead lives worthy of condemnation
Withstand death/necromantic/underworld-based or infernal effects (Death Inducing, etc)
weaknesses: No Astral Eviction/Banishment or Astral Trapping until the higher levels (NCN)
No Astral Realm Perception, Astral Energy Perception or Psychopompism until the higher levels (NCN)
Immortals, Astral Trappers, etc; behavior-altering abilities can negate Pro #1 and #2

name: Black Enchanter
description: A person with dark or demonic based powers can use this ability to implant a portion of their power into an inanimate object. By doing this the object becomes a cursed artifact with demonic abilities of its own.
summary: The ability to only individuals with demonic or otherwise dark powers can use this ability.
strengths: The person becomes a dark enchanter using his own soul force to create demonic items.
The items become independent entities with their own unique abilities that they can trigger on their
weaknesses: The enchanter loses power for a short period of time because of the implantation.
Too much enchanting can leave the enchanter to weak to maintain living.

name: Lilies Of Lilith
description: This is also knnown as 'Blessing of Lilith. ' Lilith is supposedly the mother of all demons and a vampire. The lily is her symbol. This power makes vampires slightly demonic and vice versa. You can with this power control shadows, other vampires/demons without regard for rank, and summon magical lilies. The lilies can explode like a mine, heal, and more. Your blood also becomes undrinkable to vampires unless you want them to drink it. All your attributes are also enhanced.
summary: The ability to utilize a vampire/demon only power given with Lilith's blessing
strengths: You have Lilith's blessing which means vampires/demons won't attack you.
Doesn't matter if you're a shinso or devil you can control anyone else of your race.
You also gain the special powers of the strongest of your race (Vampires-shinso, demons-devil).
weaknesses: This can only be used by vampires and demons.
If you're a vampire or demon facing someone with this power.
Don't ask where I got my information. (Neither pro nor con)

name: Voracious Papilionoidea
description: When used, this ability creates a swarm of butterflies. These butterflies are carnivorous and will eat anything alive that's not you. You have very little (if any) control over the butterflies, barely enough to keep them from eating allies or bystanders. The coloration of the butterflies varies from person to person. The size of the swarm and the control over the butterflies depend on the person's experience with the power.
summary: The ability to summon a swarm of flesh-eating butterflies
strengths: They will eat the annoying people
Their size and the fact that they fly mean that they will be difficult to stop
They're like flying insectoid piranhas!
weaknesses: Insecticides
Bug-controlling powers
They might eat people you don't want them to eat..

name: Marked For Death
description: If you want someone dead, all you do is shake their hand & a crimson black pus-oozing rash will appear on their palm. A year from now, they will die unless they sacrifice everything they hold dear including shaking someone else's hand with the cursed hand. After that they must cut their own hand off & give it to you as "a pound of flesh" payment for the death curse to be lifted & transferred to the last person they shook hands with. Just hope they don't place it on your loved ones.
summary: The ability to put a death sentence on someone unless they give something to you
strengths: Torment someone that they will die unless they vow poverty life & deliver pound of flesh
weaknesses: Better hope they don't shake hands & pass the curse to your family & friends

name: Antimatter Mirror
description: The Antimatter Mirror is an object and is also a doorway to the dark, violent, opposite universe. Within dwells the name Sabra Deck Stun, an imprisoned ghost (resembling the eyebrows, vile yellow-greenish eyes, and the triangular lips with yellow/brown teeth surroned by silver smoke) who always speaks malevolently The mirror can even give you a glimpse of what we look like if we were evil.
summary: The ability to see what we look like if we are evil or travel in it to see what's different.
strengths: It's also a gateway to an evil dimension.
None.
weaknesses: Totally vile object to use.
If the mirror is broken and you are stuck in a dark evil universe you can't go back.

name: Myth Power: Pandora's Box
description: In Greek Myth, Pandora's Box is known to contain all the sins, wicked things and negativity about the natural world. This power lets you harness its capability. The user of this ability is capable of summoning the box at will and using it to do one of a few things. He can open it and release a spirit to possess or torment the foe. He can use the box to CAPTURE evil spirits, whether they belong in the box or not. Or he can release Hope to assist him in his time of need.
summary: The ability to channel the power contained within Pandora's Box
strengths: Summon Pandora's box at will
Can be used to release evil spirits which torment the foe (or drive him into sinful acts)
Can also be used to CAPTURE evil spirits (or release Hope to help you or allies)
weaknesses: Only a few evil spirits can be released at a time
Evil spirits that don't belong in the box may be hard to catch (and even harder to keep in)
If you do something particularly evil (or with evil intentions), Hope won't come out to help you

name: Summoning: Laplace
description: The demon Laplace is an incredibly odd demon, with an amazing power. It knows everything that has ever happened, and everything that ever will happen. Some say it even knows the exact placement of every molecule and every atom in the universe. Using this, you can know your own future, and the future of others.
summary: The ability to summon Laplace.
strengths: Can know anyone's future.
weaknesses: Some people might go insane knowing such things.

name: Summon Pyk Cloud
description: Pyks are 1000 times smaller than nanites. A fog-like cloud of them numbers in the quadrillions. A pyk cloud will be dispersed by a strong wind or explosion, but individual pyks have a gathering instinct with a range of 5 miles. A cloud has a collective IQ and knowledge of sub-atomic manipulation. Anything nanite-sized or larger can be easily dismantled. Under super-powered magnification, a pyk looks like a demonic handy man. Pyks can't be merged with or absorbed by other kystians.
summary: The ability to summon a vast horde of picoscopic kystians.
strengths: Sub-atomic level manipulators of matter.
Makes nanotechnology crude-looking.
Picotechnology (or this power) has great uses still unthought of.
weaknesses: This power doesn't give you knowledge of sub-atomic manipulation.
You don't have knowledge of the sub-atomic physics.
Air powers, strong winds or explosions.

name: Death Revelation
description: Usually, the violence of the death or just the shock of realizing what happened can cause the ghost or spirit to forget how they died, or even that they are dead. This can be troublesome to them as they can continue their everyday life and end up haunting places. This power allows you to see them and make them relive what happened to them. Beware that the second shock could very well cause them to evolve into something much worse, like a poltergeist or an avenging spirit.
summary: The ability to reveal to spirits and ghosts how they died.
strengths: You can help spirits remember how they died.
You can help ghosts realize they are dead.
You could help ghosts resolve their death and move on to the afterlife.
weaknesses: The shock of the revelation could give a wide array of powers to the ghost or spirit.

name: Flabellum Euri/Australe
description: Whenever you say "Adeat", a pair of fans appear. These fans have the special ability to heal a person's injuries as long as it has occured within 3 minutes. Has a spell that can completely heal a person. The full name of the arifact is Flabellum Euri and Flabellum Australe.
summary: The ability to summon a pair of fans that can be used to heal.
strengths: Can heal small wounds instantly.
weaknesses: Cannot heal injuries that have occured over 3 minutes ago.
The spell that can heal a person completely can only be used once a day.

name: Art Style: Dark Theater Masks
description: When the masks are summoned a ghostly body will come from the mask and depending on the facial expression thats how that certain mask will act. The masks are anger, sorrow, happy, lazy, brave, and scared. There are probably more but those are yet to be discovered.
summary: The ability to control masks as puppets
strengths: Very powerful
Can double team an opponent
Attacks can be timed and combined
weaknesses: The most that was ever summoned was 5
You have to have a good relationship with all masks or they could turn on you

name: Artifact: Oculus Corvinus
description: When you say "Adeat", six small spy satellites appear. They can be sent anywhere in the world and can be used to gather information.
summary: The ability to summon six small spy satellites.
strengths: Are small and hard to notice.
Can give info on things such as name, age, height, etc.
weaknesses: Can still be noticed.
Has no combat purposes.

name: Monster In Your Closet V2
description: With this power you can cause any monster (dragon, werewolf, zombie, vampire etc. ) to appear in any closet in the world. You cannot send the monsters back to where they came from.
summary: The ability to cause any monster to appear in any closet in the world
strengths: You can cause monsters to appear in any closet
weaknesses: You cannot send the monsters back
The monsters are not under your control

name: Bucket Of Random
description: You use the bucket to pull out anything from any dimension even your own and use it to your advantage or disadvantage. The power is based totally off of luck.
summary: The ability to use it to pull out anything at random
strengths: Could be awesome
Its random
weaknesses: Could horribly fail and end up killing you by being a grenade thats about to blow up.
Its random

name: Moon Blade 5th: Void Black
description: A completely black blade. By pointing at the target, you can open a portal at the tip of the sword (about a meter in area) to suck all souls in its vicinity. If a target is killed with this sword, his soul is trapped inside, and can only be released through a long ritual.
summary: The ability to create a soul eater sword.
strengths: Powerful sword that allows for killing multiple enemies.
The captured souls will have it pretty rough in there (torturing).
Can be used with any other moon blades.
weaknesses: *CAUTION* Can also take your soul if you cannot control it.
Be careful not to touch your allies with it.

name: Poker Chips
description: With this power you have several controls over poker chips. You can summon and levitate poker chips that you own. You can also turn poker chips into what they are worth, such as turning a 100$ poker chip into 100 dollars. This can work in reverse as well as you can turn inanimate objects into detailed poker chips with designs based on the object you transformed. If the poker chips are lost in a bet then the new owner of the chips can change the chips into their value, but not back into a chip.
summary: The ability to have poker chip based powers.
strengths: Have control over poker chips that you own.
Turn poker chips into their real world value.
Turn inanimate objects into detailed poker chips.
weaknesses: Only works on poker chips that you own.
If poker chips are lost in a bet you do not have control over them.
If you are a bad gambler.

name: Eye Of  Heck
description: Using this ability you can send someone's soul directly into the fires of heck by looking them directly in the eye. While they are in heck every second of torture will feel like a year or decade instead. Once their soul is in heck you have two choices. 1 return their soul to their body after five seconds. 2 leave their soul in heck for the rest of eternity and keep their body as your loyal slave.
summary: The ability to send someone's soul to heck by looking them directly in the eye
strengths: Paralyze your enemies
Break the minds of the weak hearted.
If you're evil, create an army of souless minions
weaknesses: Never look in a mirror and activate this power... Ever
You have to make direct eye contact
Jack Card Spirits

name: Soul Picture
description: If you take a person's picture 5 minutes (or less) before they die, will allow you to transfer their soul to the photograph upon death. Taking a ghost's picture, will transfer it to the picture immidiately. The old type camera is to be used, the one that instantly makes a picture for you. Note, the camera just marks the soul for entrapment, it does not actually kill the person.
summary: The ability to trap someone's soul in a photograph.
strengths: Allows you to save a person from completely leaving this world.
Allows you to trap an evil soul.
ALlows you to see person's time on death (can turn off) while looking through a camera at them.
weaknesses: Unless you can make artificial bodies for souls.
If someone sees that you take pictures, and then people die, questions might be asked.

name: Half Nekomata
description: Someone with this power will have claws, catlike ears, and 2 tails. They will also have higher physical speed, reflexes and magical power than most humans. They will also be able to steal power from spirits in times of great need and can become invisible when they want.
summary: The ability to be half-human, half-nekomata
strengths: Most people cannot hit you in a fight.
Note: Nekomata can also be called Bakeneko (Ghost Cat).
weaknesses: Most Yokai and other mythical creatures will consider you to be inferior.

name: Boot To The Face
description: Have you ever been so annoyed you wanted to put a boot to someone's face? Well, with this power, you can summon a boot that'll slam into someone's face until you are satisfied.
summary: The ability to summon a Boot to the Face.
strengths: Boot to the Face anyone.
weaknesses: What bad sides? It's a Boot to the Face.

name: Weapon: Durendal
description: Durendal is a holy weapon wielded by Roland. With this weapon, you can attack unholy foes and cause divine punishment on evil in the form of lightning. It can be stolen and used by others and it cannot be destroyed by mortal or magical means. Holy weapons are downgraded versions of divine weapons and equal in capacity to magic class weapons
summary: The ability to wield Durendal
strengths: Holy Type Weapon
It has infinite durability cannot be broken by normal magic or physical force
weaknesses: Like many other weapons this weapon can be stolen
Can be destroyed by divine power

name: Death Metal Muse
description: You are the Muse the other Muses kicked out of the band. Your divine music was so extremely dark and brooding that anyone who could hear it and was just far enough away to understand your lyrics dropped dead. You do need a least one decent size speaker and a electric guitar to drop people dead. Your divine power will magically power enough both.
summary: The ability to play music so brutally people will drop dead.
strengths: Death metal fans will adore you!
Death metal fans might not care about all dropping dead part!
weaknesses: You can never have a concert.
Your music kills people-thousands if you pack a stadium.

name: Ghost Annihilating Soags
description: Saogs are anti-matter versions of ghosts but can interact with normal non-ectoplasmic matter without harm. It's contact with ectoplasm that that causes saogs to explode. This contact also causes the ectoplasmic being to explode at the same time. Just like matter and anti-matter.
summary: The ability to summon beings made of anti-ectoplasm.
strengths: Protection from ghosts
Saogs have ghost like powers of flying and phasing.
Soags are anti-ectoplasm so not affected by ectoplasm control powers.
weaknesses: Ectoplasm in any form will make a soag explode. Ectoplasmic weapons will work.
Saogs don't have the power of possession.

name: Odour Whisperer
description: With this power, you see odours as if they were ghosts. They appear as coloured, gaseous spirits to you, clear as day. How good the smell is dictates the mental alignment of the odour; good smells are benevolent and handsome/beautiful, the bad smells are ghastly and twisted figures, and evil/bad. They will tell you how they were created, and they can attach themselves to you so that you can bring them along with you. Some may be your friend for life, or your worst nightmare.
summary: The ability to see, interact and speak with odours
strengths: Communicate with, see and carry sentient, living smell.
If it is a good smell, the scent is benevolent.
Detect who farted... Good for blackmail.
weaknesses: Some smells aren't so good
The bad smells are evil/bad
There are some smells you should not know about.

name: Acultomancy
description: Acultomancy can tell the future, and other things, through small pointy pieces of metal. It specializes in the question "Where". Acultomancers put(or hold) needles on a flat surface. After thinking about what they want to find, the needles will spin and point in the direction of the thing. Compasses are used often for convenience. Acultomancers can find almost anything, and often have an inborn sense of direction. Better Acultomancers can find things faster, or more easily.
summary: The ability to divine information through needles
strengths: Never lose your keys again!
Make use of a compass.
weaknesses: You have to carry needles... Ouch..
Can't tell you many things outside of "Where"

name: Spirit Possession
description: You become a ghost lightning rod, meaning you can attract spirits & have them possess you. This makes you stronger. Downside is it only lasts an hour & only three spirits can possess you. Also, an evil spirit might possess & control you.
summary: The ability to become possessed by spirits, becoming stronger.
strengths: Virtually talk to the dead
Become stronger
weaknesses: Only be possessed for a hour
Only three spirits can possess you
An evil spirit might try to take control over you

name: Angel Power: Angel's Robe
description: This ability allows you to summon an angel's robe to wear. The robe provides you with a feeling of inner peace and courage, heightened physical and mental strength, heightened durability, and immunity to energy attacks. However, you can only wear the robe if you have good intentions (otherwise, the warm light that radiates from it will feel burning to the touch and blinding to look at).
summary: The ability to channel the robe of an angel
strengths: Feel inner peace, comfort and courage
Heightened physical and mental strength
Immunity to energy attacks, and resistance to physical attacks
weaknesses: It doesn't work against people who aren't evil
If you're wicked, the robe can harm YOU too...
It doesn't make you invulnerable to harm, it just increases your durability

name: Summoning: Asura
description: The Asura are a group of power seeking deities, sometimes referred to as the Demon Gods. You can summon one of these powerful demons for YOUR use.
summary: The ability to summon the Demon Gods.
strengths: Powerful Demon ally.
Various powers for each Asura.
weaknesses: May be too strong to control.
Will devour you if you lose control.

name: Devil Music
description: Imagine if you want to do all the dark evil things you want to do to everyone just by playing one of those Musical instruments tainted by the man way down below (Satan), and you'll be able to summon every type of demons underground, corrupt their minds, and make them forfeit their soul.
summary: The ability to summon demons from the underworld and corrupt innocents while playing a Musical instrument.
strengths: None Really.
weaknesses: Extremely corruptive.

name: Summon Chiron
description: With this power you are able to summon the wise Centaur and teacher of heroes, Chiron. While Chiron is not under your control if you are a hero or want to be a hero he will probably help you and train you and maybe even help you battle. You can unsummon him whenever you want.
summary: The ability to summon the wise centaur Chiron
strengths: You can summon Chiron
He'll probably help you out
weaknesses: He can die
You'll probably have to hide him from the public eye

name: Super Moderator
description: Correct spelling and grammar errors, check for any rule/guideline violations, and approve or disapprove instantly just by looking at it.
summary: The ability to instantly approve or reject a superpower correctly at first glance
strengths: Might be good if you are a moderator
Never unfair, always right
weaknesses: Only bad if you like taking the time to review a superpower

name: Moon Blade 8th: Shark Gray
description: This blade looks like it's made from gray shadow. Any magical thing hit by the blade is destroyed. For example, another magical sword, a magic armour or a transformation. They will be destroyed forever, even if they have the ability to repair themselves.
summary: The ability to summon a blade of destruction.
strengths: Can destroy anything magical.
Good to make the enemy completely powerless and then watch them suffer.
weaknesses: Careful not to hit yourself.
Doesn't work on stuff like laser vision, unless you hit their eyes (but they'd be dead then)
Has no actual offensive/defensive abilities (the enemy may have a normal sword+super strength)

name: Dark Powers: Book Of Corruption
description: With this power you can summon the book of corruption. It teaches most of the Dark Powers, including the ones with Summon, Transform, Curse and Awakening type powers. This book also gives it's user the power of corrupting the souls of people who hear you talking it's Real Name, which cant be write in any human language. There are only 13 of those books in the entire multiverse. This book is for villains only.
summary: The ability to summon the book of corruption, which can corrupt the soul of anyone with its words.
strengths: Gives you access to all the other Dark Powers.
Gives you a bonus power of corrupting the souls of people who hear you talking it's Real Name.
weaknesses: This power is really rare, you probably would be the only person in the multiverse with this power.
This book corrupts your soul too, turning you evil.

name: Muppet Power Newsman's Curse
description: Have you ever watched the Muppet Show and seen those Muppet Newsflash sketches and thought "Hah whatever that guy is reporting about falls on his head that's hilarious! "? Well on the off chance that you have, with this power you can do that too. Now whenever you talk about something it will fall from the sky onto your head. For example if you're talking to your friend about lotteries or large amounts of cash, large amounts of cash will fall on you. This power does not work on people.
summary: The ability to cause whatever you were talking about to fall on your head
strengths: You can cause anything that you're talking about to fall onto your head
You can turn this power on and off
weaknesses: This power does not work with people

name: Ars Goetia: Leraje's Bow
description: The handsome demon archer clad in green known as Leraje. His spiritual arrows cause gangrene wounds. Being a Great Marquis of hell, the archer also has thirty demonic legions under their control.
summary: The ability to acquire the demonic archer's bow.
strengths: Neutralize enemies with spiritual arrows.
The quiver spawns arrows so you will never run out.
Thirty legions under control.
weaknesses: May frighten loved ones.
Demonic beauty.

name: Manna Invocation
description: With this ability, you must raise your hands toward the sky, and within a seconds, the clouds will pour forth manna, the divine food provided by God to the Jews in the Bible, when they had to wander the desert for 40 years. Also spelled mana, this food is said to be sweet to the taste, and obviously nutritious enough that your can sustain yourself on this alone for at least 40 years. You can call it forth in as vast a quantity as you desire, but only as long as you have a rapport with God.
summary: The ability to cause manna to fall from the sky
strengths: Call forth food from the sky
The manna is tasty, and nutritous enough to be a sole source of nutrition for at least 40 years
If you don't feel hungry, then just call forth manna to bury foes in it
weaknesses: Only summons manna (no other foods)
If you are anti-God, unfortunately, this power won't work for you

name: Legendary Turtle King
description: Summon spell through imagination, creating a real oversize talking turtle that you can control to crush your enemies, spew enormous stream of water and provide transportation for as long as you want.
summary: The ability to cast spell by summoning a gigantic talking turtle.
strengths: Eliminates pyromancers on the battle field.
Intangibility: A walking giant fortress on your side of the field.
weaknesses: Creates small earthquakes when it walks.
Don't mention, " turtle soup" or you'll find out what happen next!

name: Zero's Scroll: Black Water
description: Once there was a magician named Black Zero, and with him he carried a scroll of all his spells and more. You managed to catch a glimpse of his scroll, and learned his first spell, Black Water. This spell summons forth water as dark as a moonless night. This water acts like acid, and can burn through even metal within seconds.
summary: The ability to use Black Water.
strengths: Use black water.
Acidic water.
weaknesses: Hard to use.

name: Curse Separation
description: A person with this power can cause a curse to separate from its host. The host turns back to normal while the curse takes on the form of the host while the host was under the effects of the curse. The new curse being has a will of its own and will try to spread the curse to other people. If the new curse being is killed, the curse will cease to exist for those it has affected. This power works on things such as vampirism, lycanthropy, Zombification, and etc.
summary: The ability to separate a curse into a new being from its host.
strengths: Release a person from a curse.
Create a new being to spread curses faster.
Side effect is being immune to curses because you can remove them from yourself.
weaknesses: The curse being has its own will and could infect people against your will.
The curse being has to be killed to remove the curse from the world permanently.
Even if the curse is killed, identical curses might still exist.

name: Muppet Monster Summon
description: With this power you can summon any Muppet Monster (Sweetums, Doglion, Thog, Behemoth etc. ) and any Sesame Street monster (Elmo, Cookie Monster, Grover/Super Grover). Even though they are not under your control, I'm sure they would help you with your problems unless of course if you're a villain. When you're done with them you could just send them back to their universe. Also they are not puppets when you summon them, but actual monsters.
summary: The ability to summon any of the Muppet Monsters.
strengths: You can summon any Muppet Monster.
Some of them are super strong, others can fly.
They will help you if you're a good guy.
weaknesses: They won't help you if your a bad guy.

name: Atlas Syndrome
description: This ability is a curse to the bearer and a blessing to those around them. In mythology Atlas was forced to carry the weight of the sky on his own. With this power the user instantly takes on the direct burdens, physical or otherwise, of those near them. In order to cope with these burdens the user adapts in a manner that will allow them to cope with, but not eliminate the problem. In addition, any actual physical burden where the afflicted is stuck will trap the user once they take it on.
summary: The ability to bear any burden, affliction, or challenge.
strengths: Situational Adaptation( Superhuman strength, Flight, speed, etc) to manage a burden.
Free your friends and allies of any burdens that would hold them back.
You will be freed from a burden if you can use skills other than this power to solve it.
weaknesses: You need to be able to solve something without this power to be freed.
All burdens are involuntary until developed. NCN
You could potentially be trapped in place forever, made immortal to bear a physical burden.

name: Myth Power: Tabliope's Gambit
description: Tabliope, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the gamble; gambling and games of chance. As such, channeling her allows one to psychically summon playing cards and dice; one gains skill in using cards to divine the future, like Tarot cards. In addition, one can channel kinetic energy through cards, to use them as throwing blades or explosives. One can even use a roll of the dice to induce a random effect on reality; the number indicated by a dice roll is the time (in sec/min/hrs) the effect lasts.
summary: The ability to channel Tabliope's command over the essence of the gamble, and games of risk and random chance
strengths: Psychically summon playing cards and dice; gain skill in using playing cards like Tarot cards
Channel kinetic force through playing cards, to use them as throwing blades or explosives
Randomly manipulate reality/probability with a dice roll; never helps foes, or harms self/allies
weaknesses: Cannot psychically perceive or manipulate probability until the higher levels (NCN)
Psychic manipulation of probability NEVER affects SUMMONED cards or dice (NCN)
Probability/chance/luck-based MythPowers and Unpredictability provide immunity (NCN)

name: Road Rage
description: With this ability, you can cause any car that's PISSIN YOU OFF to get the hell out of the way.  They will magically be forced to move out of your way, and, if you want, you can give them the finger while doing it.  Basically, this will satisfy any road rage you might have.
summary: The ability to force any car (or cars) out of your way at any given time.  Includes rush hour!
strengths: Get place faster
You're never late because of traffic
Rush hour is a fun time
weaknesses: You might force an ambulance to wait

name: Infernal Demons
description: Demons and spirits can contact you from the underworld, another plane of existence or wherever they come from. In return for releasing them, they will offer you something as a reward. You can accept or reject the offer, or you may make an counter-offer. You'll have a gut feeling where and when they will spawn. No traces/evidence will be left to implicate you for the spawning of the creatures, they will not remember you set them free. You yourself can also choose to not remember this.
summary: The ability to release demons and spirits if they offer you something
strengths: No evidence to implicate you, even you can forget if you want to; despite memory powers
Creatures come in different shapes and forms (hands, animals, human-like) and have their own powers
You can choose when you want to hear offers, so you don't hear them all the time.
weaknesses: They have to obey the agreement, but after fullfillment, they don't disappear
Each demon has it's own personality and attitude. They might turn on you if you're not careful.
They can be destroyed or exorcised

name: Independant Action
description: This is less of a power for you, and more a power for anything you summon with magic. With this power any creature you summon will persist in this realm for up to three days after you have been killed. More if they can find another source of Mana to draw from.
summary: The ability to have your summoned minions persist after your death.
strengths: Have your minions stick around after you die.
Have them put your plans into action or take revenge on your killer.
They may find a way to revive you.
weaknesses: You will be dead.
This power could make certain beings harder to controll.

name: Summon Snickerdoodles
description: Ability to summon the best tasting snickerdoodles.
summary: The ability to summon snickerdoodles.
strengths: Snickerdoodles taste good.
weaknesses: THERE IS NOTHING BAD WITH SNICKERDOODLES.

name: Prayer To The Dragon, Dagiozzi
description: You have to enter a state of perfect peace (not Heaven!) as you pray. It goes like this: "Aumento, dea del mare, Aumento, drago della giustizia, La mia lingua ti chiama. Benedizioni tuo elargire indegni, Abbiamo bisogno di forza tua, Ci protegga, Esiliatore del male. " What's lame is that you have to pronounce it in native Italian.
summary: The ability to summon the holy guardian from the depths.
strengths: Dagiozzi is a sea goddess. What's not cool about that?
She will follow almost every bidding, but your intentions must be pure.
She can swim, fly, walk, and is 35 feet tall. And you can ride on her. Wee!
weaknesses: If you're not Italian.
She's a goddess, so pervert her and die!
It has a duration of one day, and a cooldown of two, so don't get into any trouble for two days.

name: Demonic Contract
description: When you are dying, you can summon a demon and sign a contract with them. The contract can have any terms either side wants but must be agreed on by both sides. The only conditions that cannot be changed are that you will be revived with your body at the prime of your life and that the demon will travel with you at all times. You cannot get god-like powers from this nor can the demon. You have five minutes to write up the contract and if neither side can agree, you die by aging rapidly.
summary: The ability to make a contract with a demon when one is dying
strengths: Can make whatever terms you want.
Revived from the brink of death at your body's best condition and have a 'bodyguard'.
Can get a load of powers.
weaknesses: Both you and the demon must agree to the terms of the contract.
Must be dying in order to use and doesn't work with old age.
Have a time limit of five minutes to write up contract and sign it or you die.

name: Enhancement: Ghost Harming
description: This is a support. It does nothing until attached to another power. When attached, it makes the power harm only ghosts and other astral beings. This power can only be attached to one power at a time. If this power is stolen, the power it is attached to is permanently enhanced.
summary: The ability to make a power harm ghosts instead of living beings
strengths: Can get rid of those pesky ghosts.
weaknesses: Useless without another power.
Only allows harming ghosts.

name: Myth Power: Phrike's Fright
description: Phrike, in Greek myth, was the goddess of horror and shivering, shuddering, trembling fear. As such, channeling her gifts one with a presence like a ghost's, which lowers the temperature in radius, and sends chills (of fear AND cold) up a subject's spine; the effect is amplified by touch. In addition, one can cast illusions to make oneself seem more frightening (taking on a demonic voice, monstrous facial features, etc) at will. One can even entirely withstand the effects of fear and cold.
summary: The ability to channel Phrike's command over the essence of horror and shivering
strengths: One has a cold, disturbing, ghost-like presence and touch (also makes ghosts less likely to attack)
Cast an illusion to make oneself sound or appear more scary/frightening
Withstand the effects of cold and fear; share Cold Immunity and Fear Immunity by touch
weaknesses: Only summon, communicate with and compel horror story monsters/demons/killers at higher levels (NCN)
Only teleport self/others to and from a fictional horror universe at the higher levels (NCN)
MythPower: Phobos' Fear, MythPower: Deimos' Dread and the like provide immunity (NCN)

name: The Barrier Before Gods
description: Whenever you want, you can act like a passage for anything that is addressed to a deity by humans. You will know what it is and the choice is entirely yours to let it through or not. Once it's through, you cannot take it back though. Basically, you can prevent prayers from reaching gods or interrupt someone before they channel a god's power or before they summon one.
summary: The ability to peek at anything addressed to gods and stop it.
strengths: Prevent prayers from reaching gods.
Prevent someone from summoning a god.
Prevent someone from channeling the powers of a god.
weaknesses: You need to activate this power to know when someone is trying to contact a god.
If you let it through, it's too late to come back on your decision.

name: Stubborn Mind Curse
description: You can alter anyone's mind to make it so rigid they can't understand any speech or sentence if there's a grammatical or orthographical mistake in it. Their mind just can't do the gymnastics to interpret the mistake and read the correct word or just figure out the gist. They also can't read upside down or backwards. The upside is they will never make any mistakes when they write or speak.
summary: The ability to make anyone's mind so inflexible, they can't understand a speech or text if there's a mistake.
strengths: Corntray to the rscheearch, it deos mttaer to tehm in waht oredr the ltteers in a wrod are.
They can't make head or tail of "10 items or less" and similar anomalies.
They would have so much trouble with SMS language.
weaknesses: Too bad George W. Bush isn't the president anymore. It would have been so troublesome.
They would become spelling bee champions.

name: God Phone V5
description: With this power you can summon any of the ancient Chinese Gods and Goddesses. They are not under your control but if you have a good enough reason for calling them they may help you, if not they'll probably destroy you. You can only send them back if they want to be sent back.
summary: The ability to summon any of the ancient Chinese Gods and Goddesses
strengths: You can summon any of the Chinese Gods and Goddesses
They might help you if you have a good enough reason for summoning them
weaknesses: They might destroy you
They might not help you
They are not under your control

name: Fickle Genie
description: This power allows the user to summon a genie that will grant the user three of their wishes. However, you will not be able to simply make three wishes. You will need to make 1000 different wishes of the genie, of which it will choose three at random to grant.   Anyone you allow may use the genie, but only one person may use the genie at once. You can not have 1000 different people each make one individual wish. Likewise, you can not cheat by wishing for different increments of one thing.
summary: The ability to summon a genie that will grant 3 wishes out of 1000.
strengths: The genie is all powerful, and will always grant three of your wishes.
weaknesses: Long start up time. You must repeat 1000 wishes to the genie for every three it grants.
Some people may not have that many wishes.
Every wish must be different.

name: Ghost Of The Present
description: The present ghost is a gentle jolly giant with dark brown curls, wears a fur-lined green robe and on his head a holly wreath set with shining icicles, carries a large torch made to resemble a cornucopia, appears accompanied by a great feast, has the power to change his size to fit into any space and also wears a scabbard with no sword in it which represents peace on Earth. The spirit can transport a person by swirling his torch around to let them see who they have hurt most.
summary: The ability to summon a spirit to let anyone know what is going on in the present time.
strengths: You and your present spirit see all those around you and all of them cannot see you.
weaknesses: The present spirit will only exist on earth year during a holiday.
The ghost reveals to you that he has 2 vile children chained under his robe named ignorance & want.
The spirit warns you to beware forcreating want & need

name: Which Ever Way The Winds Blows
description: You can use any object or objects to choose what you'll do. A coin, cards, dice, a random number generator. Anything else that works. Every time you do this you'll be be immune to any control powers that affect behavior, body, mind, spirit, soul or powers for a day for each time you make a decision this way. If you refuse to go with random chance, you lose a day of immunity. Any lost object can be easily replaced or made(e. G. Homemade dice), your power just works through it.
summary: The ability to let random chance control what you do and nothing else.
strengths: Immunity to control powers.
You can buy, make or steal whatever object(s) you to make the power work.
weaknesses: Some things shouldn't be left to random chance.
If you can't agreed with what random chance chose for you, lose a day of immunity.

name: Angelic Hierarchy: Dominions
description: The Dominions, also known as Hashmallim, regulate the duties of lower-ranking angels. They also preside over nations. Their appearance is described as a divinely beautiful humans with a pair of feathered wings. The Dominions may also be described as wielding orbs of light which are fastened to their swords or scepters.
summary: The ability to become an angel from the Second Sphere.
strengths: Preside over nations and countries ensuring righteous order.
Regulate laws and the tasks of subordinate angels.
Use orbs of light as a means of offense and defense.
weaknesses: Rarely making yourself visible to humans.

name: Zombie: Summon 10 Zombies
description: With this power, you can summon an army of zombies. You can summon up to 10 zombies per day. When they bite/scratch someone, their victim is infected and you get another zombie!
summary: The ability to summon up to 10 zombies per day.
strengths: If they have a leathal blow they will still do what's commanded
When they bite/scratch someone, hell! You got another zombie!
Zombies rock
weaknesses: They stink
They're ugly
They rot

name: 4 D Movies V2
description: With this power you can place a curse on someone that causes them to feel the exact same things a character in a movie feels. All you have to do is the same the name of the movie, character and the person you're cursing. Then you have to play the movie and whenever the character feels something the person will as well. If the character dies in the movie the person dies as well.
summary: The ability to cause people to feel things that characters feel in movies
strengths: You can place a curse on people that allows them to feel the same things as movie characters
weaknesses: You are not immune to this power so people can use it on you

name: Monster In Your Closet
description: With this power you can make any monster from the movie Monsters Inc appear in any closet in the planet that you're on when you use the power. The monsters are not under your control and are free to do whatever they want, scare, befriend, freak out, play bowling etc. You also don't control when they go back to their world as they can do it whenever they want just by walking back into the closet that they came though.
summary: The ability to make any monster from Monsters Inc appear in anybody's closet
strengths: You can make any monster from Monsters Inc appear in any closet on the planet that you're on
weaknesses: The monsters are not under your control

name: Fullmetal Alchemists:Lust
description: By gaining the abilities of Lust you become a symbol of beauty, and sexuality. As the saying goes, don't judge a book by its cover, you become highly intelligent, and easily deceive others. Your fingers can extend to the point of, well, there is no length limit, but your fingers can pierce anything.
summary: The ability to gain the abilities of Lust.
strengths: Symbol of beauty and sexuality.
Highly Intelligent.
Deceive others.
weaknesses: As in Dante's Inferno, fiery winds and fire are very effective.
You expect everyone's love to come to you, being very lustful.

name: Theatre Character Summon
description: With this power you can summon any character from any play that you've seen. The character you summon will look exactly like the actor that plays them but will act like the character that they're playing. The characters are not under you control and they can be unsummoned whenever you like.
summary: The ability to summon any character from any play
strengths: You can summon any character from any play that you yourself have seen
They look like the actor that plays them so you may be able to use that to your advantage somehow
weaknesses: They're not under your control
Only plays that you've seen

name: Myth Power: Ker's Curse
description: Ker (Cer) and the Keres (Ceres), in Greek myth, were the goddesses of painful, cruel and violent death. As such, channeling them allows one to perceive violent death in one's range, at will. In addition, one can psychically perceive, communicate with and compel the undead (ghosts/spirits, zombies, etc) of those who died violently. Furthermore, one can perceive and mimic, by a paralyzing touch, foes' most feared mode of death. One can even withstand death/underworld/afterlife-based effects.
summary: The ability to channel Ker and the Keres' command over the essence of painful, cruel and violent death
strengths: Psychically perceive past, present and future violent death in one's range at will
Psychically perceive, communicate with and compel undead who died violent deaths
Perceive and mimic, by touch, foe's most feared mode of violent death; withstand necromantic effects
weaknesses: Cannot generate wings to fly until the higher levels (NCN)
Cannot summon fairy/pixie-like Avatars of the Keres to attack foes until the higher levels (NCN)
Death/underworld/afterlife-based MythPowers (and Immortality) provide immunity (NCN)

name: Summoning: Nekomata
description: Nekomata, meaning Forked Cat. It is a cat with two tails, but other than that appears to be a normal cat. It has the power to raise the dead if it walks over a corpse. They are tricky creatures to use, because even master summoners can't stop their whimsical nature. They are great companions, however, if you can befriend them.
summary: The ability to summon a Nekomata.
strengths: Raise the dead.
Useful companion
weaknesses: Hard to master.
Incredibly hard to impose your will upon.

name: Bloons Tower Defense Summon
description: Using this power, you can summon any of the towers from any of the Bloons Tower Defense series of games. You cannot, however, summon any of the Bloons. The towers are 3D, and throw real objects at any target. You have complete control over the actions of the towers. However, you cannot upgrade the towers. You also cannot summon the Road Spikes, Monkey Glue, or Pineapples.
summary: The ability to summon any tower from the Bloons Tower Defense series of games.
strengths: Summon BTD towers to do your bidding.
Can use the towers to defend yourself and your friends.
Complete control over the towers.
weaknesses: Only one tower at a time.
You cannot summon any of the upgraded towers.
The bomb towers have a bigger explosion than you think.

name: Pokemon Ranger
description: You can summon a Pokemon species if a that species acted kind toward you.
summary: The ability to summon Pokemon minions for every friendly Pokemon you have ever met.
strengths: They are your minion.
weaknesses: Cannot summon unless they have shown you kindness

name: Head Wing
description: With this power you can sprout different kinds of wings from the sides of your head. You get different powers depending on what kind of wings you sprout. If you sprout angel wings you can teleport to Heaven, if you sprout butterfly wings you can shrink down to the size of a butterfly, if you sprout fairy wings you have limited knowledge of magic and magic spells. If you sprout dragon wings you can shoot fire from the wings. Bird wings allow you to fly normally, bat wings make you grow fangs etc.
summary: The ability to sprout wings from the sides or your head
strengths: You can gain different powers by sprouting different kinds of wings from your head
You can make the wings disappear if you want
weaknesses: They have to sprout from your head

name: Myth Power: Boule's Bonus
description: Boule, in Greek myth, was the goddess of the council; a group of people who help make decisions in society. As such, channeling her allows one to summon nearly anybody one chooses, as astral-projection copies, to offer advice and information, at will. In addition, to avoid potential harm, or to avoid exposing one's ability, one may move into an extradimensional 'Council Space', at will. One may even step into the Council Space at one location, and step out of it at another location, at will.
summary: The ability to channel Boule's command over the essence of the council
strengths: Summon astral-projection copies of nearly anyone (famous, etc) to offer advice/information at will
Travel into a customizable 'Council Space' to avoid danger, or avoid exposing one's ability
Use 'Council Space' for Teleportation (time passes much slower in Council Space)
weaknesses: Only travel to Council Space when one feels subconscious need for help until developed (NCN)
Cannot bring others into (or trap foes within) the Council Space until developed (NCN)
Astral Council Members can only offer knowledge from their real-life counterpart's perspective (NCN)

name: Summoning: Wraith
description: A Wraith is a ghost, who as a human held an incredible amount of rage and hatred. A Wraith is a malevolent spirit who will steal the life of anyone you hate. However, if the Wraith can't steal the life of the one you hate, it will come back and steal your life instead.
summary: The ability to summon a Wraith.
strengths: Kill basically anyone you feel hatred towards.
weaknesses: Will steal your own life if it fails for some reason.

name: Divine Form: Anubis
description: A priest of Anubis can allow the spirit of Anubis to take over his body temporarily granting him incredible powers. They can also change their own people into Jackal headed creatures, which have often been confused for were-wolves.
summary: The ability to temporarily channel the spirit of Anubis into your body
strengths: Temporary invicibility
Near indestructibility
Able to empower an entire army
weaknesses: Leaves you completely drained, physically and mentally
Cannot hold on to the spirit for long; your body cannot hold divinity for too long
Have to be in peak human condition or may be fatal

name: Myth Power: Alastor's Alliance
description: Alastor, in Greek myth, was the god of blood feuds, as well as inflictor of divine vengeance upon younger generations, for the sins of their fathers. As such, this ability allows one to perceive one's foe's paternal bloodline. For every criminal, villain or other ne'er-do-well they have in their paternal bloodline, one curse or plague may be inflicted on them (and if you are their rival, the power increases). In addition, simply having this ability absolves one's bloodline of any past misdeeds.
summary: The ability to channel Alastor's command over the essence of blood feuds
strengths: Perceive the sins of a foe's paternal bloodline (father, grandfather, great-grandfather, etc)
For every bad guy in a foe's paternal bloodline, one curse or plague may be put on the foe himself
This ability absolves one's own paternal bloodline; withstand law/order/justice-based MythPowers
weaknesses: One can only punish foes for their PATERNAL bloodline's sins (not the mother's, aunt's, uncle's etc)
Cannot directly KILL a foe for the "sins of his father" (NCN)
Law/order/justice-based MythPowers provide immunity (NCN)

name: God Phone V6
description: With this power you can summon any of the Gods and Goddesses of Indian (the country not native americans) mythology. The Gods/Goddesses are not under your control but if you have a good enough reason for summoning them then they might help you. On the other hand they might be angry at your for summoning them and destroy you. You cannot send them back unless they want to go back.
summary: The ability to summon any of the ancient Gods and Goddesses of India
strengths: You can summon any of the Indian Gods and Goddesses
They might help you
weaknesses: They might destroy you
You cannot send them back unless they want to be sent back

name: Thirteen Treasures: The Hamper
description: One of the thirteen treasures of Britain, guarded by Merlin the demon-wizard. When food is placed in the hamper, and the hamper closed, it will increase in mass and volume to feed one hundred men.
summary: The ability to wield the Hamper of Gwyddno Long-shank
strengths: Feed all your friends!
weaknesses: It will replicate mouldy food items as well.
Requires a source food to be multiplied.

name: Magic Chuck
description: Summon Chuck Norris from a magical Yu-Gi-Oh card and win automatically.
summary: The ability to summon Chuck Norris from a card
strengths: Win epically
weaknesses: Lose the card, fail at life.
Anyone can use the card

name: God Phone V8
description: With this power you can summon any of the gods and goddesses of the Inca tribe of Native Americans. They are not under your control but they may help you if you're lucky. You cannot unsummon them unless they want to be sent back.
summary: The ability to summon any on the Inca gods and goddesses
strengths: You can summon any of the Inca gods and goddesses
They may help you
weaknesses: They probably won't help you
They can only be sent back if they want to be sent back

name: Frysnatching
description: This superpower allows the wielder to always, without fail, eat the french fry that another person was about to grab. The power is also extensible to other snacks as well, including but not limited to: potato chips, pizza slices, and chicken wings. It is able to be targeted to specific people, but will usually happen on "autopilot" even if not purposely being called upon. A blessing and a curse - it's the way of the hero.
summary: The ability to always eat the fry someone else is about to eat
strengths: You never have to worry about being frysnatched
You have the ability to consistently annoy all around you at will
People will stop trying to share your fries
weaknesses: People will stop trying to share your fries
You will consistently annoy all around you
You may not actually get the BEST fries, depending on the judgment of the fry-snatchee

name: Myth Weapon: Biscuit Damne
description: Sister weapon to ''Grimpage Eclair'', the user is able to conjure Biscuit Damne, a.. Cookie shaped shield. A cookie, a huge cookie shaped like a shield, despite the crumbly goodness of the cookie it is remarkably durable, being able to hold it's hold against forces that would be able to break though metal. The cookie has a magical force imbued that keeps it from breaking, it would take a force equal to that which blessed it to even crack the shield. The shield is also able to negate attacks.
summary: The ability to summon the shield that that thought to protect against the forces of hell.
strengths: The user is guarded against pretty much any attack without harm to him/herself.
Along with the Grimpage Eclair, the user would be a force to be reckoned with.
The shield has a rather sharp edge, easily to cut though most things with ease.
weaknesses: If the user throws the shield at something, the user would have to go get it, risking harm.
If the shield is taken from the user, the person would be able to use it against the former user.
The shield negates attacks, it would be able to stop and negate the attacks the users throws at it.

name: Wing Man's Curse
description: With this power you can place a curse on someone so that when they become attracted to someone they will become attracted to the person's friend. You can place the curse on as many people as you want and you can remove the curse whenever you want.
summary: The ability to make people become attracted to the person who's attracted to them's friend
strengths: You can place a curse on someone that causes problems between friends
You can place this curse on as many people as you want
You can remove the curse whenever you want
weaknesses: Not much use in physical combat

name: Summon: Tortegulous
description: To summon Tortegulous is to summon destruction. Tortegulous is the giant demon Turtle which once ruled.  If you wish to summon him, beware, he may go out of control. But your enemies will run in fear. You can only summon him twice a day; or risk exhausting your power completely.
summary: The ability to summon Tortegulous when in danger.
strengths: He is enormous and the ultimate battle weapon.
You might end up saving the world from aliens one day (fame).
His tail is like the end of a scythe, made of diamonds.
weaknesses: Tortegulous may mistake other people as enemies.
May only summon twice a day.
May not obey you if you are too weak.

name: Succubus's Soul Mutation
description: This ability is mainly used by females, and isn't so good with men. When used by a female, any male has to kiss the female's hand, cheek, or lips. Once this has been completed, the said male's soul will mutate as will his body, transforming him into a demon. This demon will obey the user's every commands until they die.
summary: The ability to mutate souls.
strengths: Create minions.
Ultimate slaves.
weaknesses: Odd process to use.

name: Summoning: Dante's Inferno
description: Using this you can summon any of the seven deadly sins to consume your enemy. You have to know which sin they possess, however.
summary: The ability to summon a monster from any of the seven sins.
strengths: Can destroy your enemy with ease.
weaknesses: If you possess the sin you summon, it will consume you.
Have to know their sin.

name: Mahoujutsu: Demonization
description: You enter one of the two paths of Mahoujutsu. You become a demon, boosting your strength and demon enormously, but losing your soul in the process.
summary: The ability to become a demon.
strengths: Incredible strength.
Ultimate Defense.
weaknesses: Loss of Soul.

name: Myth Power: Tartarus' Torment
description: Tartarus (or Tartaros), in Greek myth, was the god of the stormy, chaotic hell-pit by the same name. As such, channeling him allows one to perceive and communicate with demons and other evil spirits at will. In addition, one can actually make physical contact with said spirits at will. Furthermore, one can affect said spirits to either banish them (ie exorcising demons, warding them off, etc) or prevent them from entering the mortal realm. One can even invoke visions of Tartarus with a touch.
summary: The ability to channel Tartatus' command over the essence of the stormy, chaotic hell-pit
strengths: Perceive and communicate with demons and evil spirits; induce visions of Tartarus with a touch
Physically touch them at will (making one immune to demonic possession in the process)
Banish them, ward them off, seal them within the Underworld, or trap them in the Mortal Realm
weaknesses: Cannot compel evil spirits until the higher levels; hard to compel stronger ones (no Con Negation)
You can only withstand possession for as long as this power is in use
People with death-based, underworld-based or infernal MythPowers can disrupt this ability

name: Name Power: Sabbac
